 jar=next((root/loader/'build/libs').glob('*.jar'))
 text=subprocess.check_output([str(javap),'-p','-c','-v','-classpath',str(jar),cls],text=True)

    jar = root / 'runtime' / ('iris-' + loader + '-1.11.4+mc26.1.2.jar')
    classes = ['net.irisshaders.iris.uniforms.CommonUniforms', 'net.irisshaders.iris.pipeline.IrisRenderingPipeline',
               'net.irisshaders.iris.mixinterface.GpuTextureInterface', 'net.irisshaders.iris.uniforms.FrameUpdateNotifier',
               'net.irisshaders.iris.uniforms.SystemTimeUniforms', 'net.irisshaders.iris.mixin.GpuDeviceAccessor']
    text = subprocess.check_output([str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'dev/runtime/jdk25/jdk-25.0.2.jdk/Contents/Home/bin/javap'), '-p', '-s', '-classpath', str(jar), *classes], text=True)
    (out / ('iris-' + loader + '-api.txt')).write_text(text)
    required = ['generalCommonUniforms(net.irisshaders.iris.gl.uniform.UniformHolder, net.irisshaders.iris.uniforms.FrameUpdateNotifier, net.irisshaders.iris.shaderpack.properties.PackDirectives)',
                '(Lnet/irisshaders/iris/gl/uniform/UniformHolder;Lnet/irisshaders/iris/uniforms/FrameUpdateNotifier;Lnet/irisshaders/iris/shaderpack/properties/PackDirectives;)V',
                'private final net.irisshaders.iris.uniforms.FrameUpdateNotifier updateNotifier',
                'public void finalizeLevelRendering()', 'public default int iris$getGlId()', 'public void addListener(java.lang.Runnable)',
                'COUNTER', 'com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.GpuDeviceBackend getBackend()']
    for signature in required:
        if signature not in text: raise SystemExit('Missing pinned signature: ' + loader + ': ' + signature)
    bytecode = subprocess.check_output([str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'dev/runtime/jdk25/jdk-25.0.2.jdk/Contents/Home/bin/javap'), '-p', '-c', '-classpath', str(jar), classes[1]], text=True)
    (out / ('iris-' + loader + '-pipeline-bytecode.txt')).write_text(bytecode)
    start = bytecode.index('public void finalizeLevelRendering();')
    body = bytecode[start:bytecode.index('public void finalizeGameRendering();', start)]
    composite = body.index('CompositeRenderer.renderAll:()V'); final = body.index('FinalPassRenderer.renderFinalPass:()V')
    if not composite < final < body.rindex('return'): raise SystemExit('World completion ordering changed: ' + loader)
    print(loader + ': uniform injection descriptor, final notifier, GL texture ID, listener, counter and normal completion order passed')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit this explicit port's actual publisher jars and synchronous GL submission seam."""
import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, zipfile
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=root.parents[1]
javap=repo/'dev/runtime/jdk25/jdk-25.0.2.jdk/Contents/Home/bin/javap'
lock=json.loads((root/'dependencies.lock.json').read_text())
out=root/'evidence/renderer-speed-r1';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
results=[]
for loader in ('fabric','neoforge'):
    manifest=json.loads((root/(loader+'-speed-api-pins.json')).read_text())
    sources={};artifact_receipts=[];classpath=[]
    for kind in ('iris','sodium'):
        artifact=next(a for a in lock['artifacts'] if a['loader']==loader and a['kind']==kind)
        path=root/'runtime'/artifact['filename'];data=path.read_bytes()
        for algorithm,digest in artifact['hashes'].items():
            assert hashlib.new(algorithm,data).hexdigest()==digest,(loader,artifact['filename'],algorithm)
        artifact_receipts.append({'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
        z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
        if kind=='sodium' and loader=='neoforge':
            member=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('META-INF/jarjar/') and n.endswith('.jar'))
            data=z.read(member);path=out/'sodium-neoforge-inner.jar';path.write_bytes(data)
            artifact_receipts.append({'parent':artifact['filename'],'member':member,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
            z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
        classpath.append(str(path));sources.update({n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.class')})
    minecraft=pathlib.Path(manifest['minecraftConsumerArtifact'])
    data=minecraft.read_bytes();artifact_receipts.append({'path':str(minecraft),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
        sources.update({n:z.read(n) for n in manifest['pins'] if n.startswith('com/mojang/')})
    classpath.append(str(minecraft))
    for member,digest in manifest['pins'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(sources[member]).hexdigest()==digest,member
    runtime=(root/loader/'src/main/java/com/pp/shaderlod/integration/makeupquad/MakeUpQuadRuntime.java').read_text()
    backend=(root/loader/'src/main/java/com/pp/shaderlod/integration/RendererBackend.java').read_text()
    for method in re.findall(r'RendererBackend\.(\w+)\(',runtime):
        assert re.search(r'public static [^\n{};]*\b'+re.escape(method)+r'\(',backend),'Local backend method absent: '+loader+': '+method
    assert 'RendererBackend.requireOpenGl();' in runtime,'26.2 must retain exact name/class backend admission'
    java=(root/loader/'src/main/java/com/pp/shaderlod/integration/makeupquad/MakeUpQuadApiPins.java').read_text()
    java_production=java[java.index('private static final String[][] PINS'):java.index('    };')+6]
    java_pins=dict(re.findall(r'\{"([^"]+)","([a-f0-9]{64})"\}',java_production))
    assert java_pins==manifest['pins'],'Java bootstrap and audited pins differ'
    def inspect(tag,classes,verbose=False):
        text=subprocess.check_output([str(javap),'-p','-s','-v' if verbose else '-c','-classpath',':'.join(classpath),*classes],text=True)
        (out/(loader+'-'+tag+'.txt')).write_text(text);return text
    batch=inspect('batch',['net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.gpu.device.batch.GLDrawBatch','net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.gpu.device.batch.MultiDrawBatch'])
    renderer=inspect('renderer',['net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.render.chunk.DefaultChunkRenderer','net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.render.chunk.SharedQuadIndexBuffer$IndexFormat$1'])
    transformer=inspect('transformer',['net.irisshaders.iris.pipeline.transform.transformer.SodiumTransformer'],True)
    prefix='com.mojang.blaze3d.opengl.' if root.name=='26.2' else 'com.mojang.renderpearl.backend.opengl.'
    consumer=inspect('consumer',[prefix+'GlRenderPass',prefix+'GlCommandEncoder'])
    assert manifest['renderDescriptor'] in renderer,'Exact redirect descriptor changed'
    assert 'MultiDrawBatch.draw:' in renderer,'No native batch draw invocation'
    assert 'MultiDrawBatch.isFilled:Z' in renderer,'Expected cached batch lifecycle absent'
    assert 'pElementPointer' in batch and 'pElementCount' in batch and 'pBaseVertex' in batch
    assert 'multiDrawIndexed:' in batch and 'updateMaxElementCount' in batch
    assert '_draw_id = a_LightAndData[3]' in transformer,'Chunk identity is no longer a vertex attribute'
    assert 'nglMultiDrawElementsBaseVertex' in consumer and 'executeDraws:' in consumer,'Synchronous GL consumer changed'
    assert 'net/caffeinemc/mods/sodium/client/gl/device/MultiDrawBatch.class' not in sources,'Old seam unexpectedly present'
    old=(repo/'src/main/java/com/pp/shaderlod/integration/makeupquad/MakeUpQuadApiPins.java').read_text()
    old_pins=dict(re.findall(r'\{"([^"]+)","([a-f0-9]{64})"\}',old))
    wrong=[p for p,h in old_pins.items() if p not in sources or hashlib.sha256(sources[p]).hexdigest()!=h]
    assert wrong,'Old API gate must refuse actual new jars'
    development=None
    if loader=='fabric':
        development=pathlib.Path(manifest['loomDevelopmentMinecraftConsumerArtifact'])
        dev_sources=dict(sources)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(development) as z:
            for member in manifest['loomDevelopmentPins']:
                if member.startswith('com/mojang/'):dev_sources[member]=z.read(member)
        for member,digest in manifest['loomDevelopmentPins'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(dev_sources[member]).hexdigest()==digest,member
        dev_java=java[java.index('private static final String[][] LOOM_DEVELOPMENT_PINS'):java.index('    };',java.index('private static final String[][] LOOM_DEVELOPMENT_PINS'))+6]
        assert dict(re.findall(r'\{"([^"]+)","([a-f0-9]{64})"\}',dev_java))==manifest['loomDevelopmentPins']
        dev_consumer=subprocess.check_output([str(javap),'-p','-s','-c','-classpath',str(development),prefix+'GlRenderPass',prefix+'GlCommandEncoder'],text=True)
        (out/(loader+'-loom-consumer.txt')).write_text(dev_consumer)
        assert 'executeDraws:' in dev_consumer and 'nglMultiDrawElementsBaseVertex' in dev_consumer
        # Actual mixed production/development bytes must match neither whole tuple.
        changed=[m for m,h in manifest['pins'].items() if h!=manifest['loomDevelopmentPins'][m]]
        assert len(changed)==2,changed
        mixed=dict(dev_sources);mixed[changed[0]]=sources[changed[0]]
        assert all(not all(hashlib.sha256(mixed[m]).hexdigest()==h for m,h in profile.items()) for profile in (manifest['pins'],manifest['loomDevelopmentPins']))
    results.append({'loader':loader,'minecraft':root.name,'artifactPins':artifact_receipts,'classPins':len(manifest['pins']),
                    'loomDevelopmentArtifact':str(development) if development else None,'completeProfileMixRefuses':True if development else None,'oldApiRefusedMembers':wrong,'staticSeam':'PASS','runtimeDriverQualitySpeed':'UNVERIFIED'})
(root/'evidence/renderer-speed-r1/audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(root.name+': both exact loader binary seams PASS; old API admission refuses; runtime/quality/speed UNVERIFIED')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit the actual built port artifacts; never establishes applied mixins/rendering."""
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repository = root.parent.parent
expected = {str(path.relative_to(repository / 'src/main/resources')): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for path in (repository / 'src/main/resources/assets/shaderlod/adapters').rglob('*') if path.is_file()}
rows = []
for loader in ('neoforge', 'fabric'):
    module = root / loader
    suites = [ET.parse(path).getroot() for path in (module / 'build/test-results/test').glob('TEST-*.xml')]
    counts = {key: sum(int(suite.get(key, '0')) for suite in suites) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}
    assert counts['tests'] >= 124 and counts['failures'] == counts['errors'] == counts['skipped'] == 0, (loader, counts)
    jars = list((module / 'build/libs').glob('*.jar')); assert len(jars) == 1, jars
    jar = jars[0]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
        names = set(archive.namelist())
        for name, digest in expected.items():
            assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest() == digest, (loader, name)
        assert 'META-INF/LICENSE.shaderlod' in names
        import struct
        assert struct.unpack('>H', archive.read('com/pp/shaderlod/integration/RendererBackend.class')[6:8])[0] == 69, 'Java25 class major'
        assert not any('/dev/' in name or 'SpatialComposite' in name or 'ShadowCulling' in name for name in names)
        for classfile in ('com/pp/shaderlod/integration/PackSelectionTransaction.class',
                          'com/pp/shaderlod/integration/KnownRuntimeBoundary.class',
                          'com/pp/shaderlod/integration/RendererBackend.class',
                          'com/pp/shaderlod/packs/PackSelectionService.class',
                          'com/pp/shaderlod/mixin/EffectUniformsMixin.class',
                          'com/pp/shaderlod/mixin/IrisWorldCompletionMixin.class'):
            assert classfile in names, (loader, classfile)
        if loader == 'fabric':
            metadata = json.loads(archive.read('fabric.mod.json'))
            assert metadata['depends']['minecraft'] == '26.3'
            assert metadata['depends']['java'] == '>=25'
            assert metadata['depends']['fabric-api'] == '0.162.0+26.3'
            assert metadata['depends']['iris'] == '1.11.7+mc26.3'
            assert metadata['depends']['sodium'] == '0.9.2'
        else:
            metadata = archive.read('META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml').decode()
            for version in ('[26.3.0.52-beta]', '[26.3]', '[1.11.7+mc26.3]', '[0.9.2+mc26.3]'):

    def inspect(tag,classes,verbose=False):

    batch=inspect('batch',['net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.gpu.device.batch.GLDrawBatch','net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.gpu.device.batch.MultiDrawBatch'])

    transformer=inspect('transformer',['net.irisshaders.iris.pipeline.transform.transformer.SodiumTransformer'],True)
    prefix='com.mojang.blaze3d.opengl.' if root.name=='26.2' else 'com.mojang.renderpearl.backend.opengl.'

    assert '_draw_id = a_LightAndData[3]' in transformer,'Chunk identity is no longer a vertex attribute'
    assert 'nglMultiDrawElementsBaseVertex' in consumer and 'executeDraws:' in consumer,'Synchronous GL consumer changed'
    assert 'net/caffeinemc/mods/sodium/client/gl/device/MultiDrawBatch.class' not in sources,'Old seam unexpectedly present'
    old=(repo/'src/main/java/com/pp/shaderlod/integration/makeupquad/MakeUpQuadApiPins.java').read_text()

ROOT=prep.ROOT

def qualify_preflight(path,preparation_path,pin):
    record = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    require(record.get('argv')==['python3','scripts/prepare_photon_cloud_global_cost.py','--verify',str(Path(preparation_path).resolve())]
        and type(record.get('returncode')) is int and record['returncode']==0,'Standalone fresh prep verify invocation failed/differs')
    require(record.get('preparation_sha256')==pin,'Preflight preparation hash differs')
    output = json.loads(record.get('stdout',''))
    require(output.get('status')=='verified-three-current-R10-unused-global-cloud-cost-controls'
        and output.get('launch_authorized') is False and output.get('owned_live_processes')==[], 'Standalone prep verify result differs')
    actual.integer(record.get('verified_ns'),'preflight timestamp',1)

        'Raw preflight hash/write timestamp differs')
    raw_record = {k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('verified_ns','verified_time_provenance')}
    require(json.loads(raw_path.read_text())==raw_record,'Derived preflight fields differ from raw CLI receipt')
    return record




def qualify_frozen_preparation(state,path,pin):
    require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',pin or '')and prep.file_hash(Path(path))==pin,'Explicit fresh preparation hash differs')
    require(state.get('status')==prep.FINAL,'Incomplete global cloud preparation')
    for field in ('maintained_sources_sha256','runtime_sources_sha256'):
        for name,value in state[field].items():require(prep.file_hash(Path(name))==value,'Frozen source drift: '+name)
    require(quality.baseline.control_prep.current_runtime_sources()==state['runtime_sources_sha256'],'Complete current runtime source inventory differs')
    require(quality.matrix.development_fingerprints()==state['development_runtime_inputs'],'Current compiled/resource roots differ')
    external=state['independent_artifact_receipt']
    require(external['sha256']==shared.RECEIPT_SHA256 and prep.qualify_runtime_receipt(external['path'],external['sha256'])==
        (external,state['auxiliary_directory_identities'],state['production_jar']),'Exact current R10 direct receipt differs')
    require(state['production_jar']==dict(path=str(ROOT/'build/libs/shaderlod-0.1.0-dev.jar'),sha256=shared.JAR_SHA256),'Current coherent main e86 JAR differs')
    require(prep.qualify_quality_provenance()==state['quality_provenance'],'Qualified sparse quality prerequisite provenance differs')
    source=state['source_qualification']
    require(state['source_world_sha256']==source['source_world_sha256']==quality.WORLD_SHA256['coastalwater'],'Canonical source world differs')
    for name,value in source['source_files_sha256'].items():require(prep.file_hash(Path(name))==value,'Canonical source drift: '+name)
    require(prep.world_fingerprint(quality.canonical.SOURCE/'saves'/prep.WORLD)==state['source_world_sha256'],'Current canonical stopped world differs')
    item=state['complete_option_inventory'];require(prep.file_hash(Path(item['path']))==item['sha256'],'Complete Iris discovery inventory differs')
    inventories=json.loads(Path(item['path']).read_text());maps=cloud.option_maps(inventories['original']['options'])
    rows=state['launch_plan']
    require([r['arm']for r in rows]==list(ORDER)and [r['mode']for r in rows]==list(MODES),'Missing/reordered three global count arms')
    require(prep.validate_pairs(rows)==state['prepared_pairs_comparison'],'Complete prepared settings comparison differs')
    for row in rows:
        profile=Path(row['profile']);mode=row['mode'];inventory=inventories[mode]
        require(row['scene']=='coastalwater'and profile==prep.OUTPUT/row['arm']/'control'
            and row['command']==prep.command(profile)==shared.prep.command(profile),'Exact coastal profile/common Workload argv differs')
        require(inventory['option_count']==366 and inventory['options']==maps[mode]==row['expected']['expected_effective_options']
            and inventory['sha256']==quality.matrix.canonical_options_hash(maps[mode])==row['expected']['expected_effective_options_sha256'],'Complete actual only-two-count option map differs')
        for name,value in inventory['parser_dependency_sha256'].items():require(prep.file_hash(Path(name))==value,'Pinned Iris dependency differs')
        require(prep.file_hash(Path(inventory['log']))==inventory['log_sha256'],'Actual Iris discovery log differs')
        manifest=json.loads((profile.parent/'workload-manifest.json').read_text());prep.validate_manifest(manifest,maps['original'])
        require(manifest['source_qualification']==source and manifest['experiment_arms']['control']==row['expected'],'Complete frozen source/model manifest differs')
        for name,value in row['prepared_profile']['parent_files_sha256'].items():require(prep.file_hash(Path(name))==value,'Frozen parent recipe differs')
        require(json.loads((profile/'workload-request.json').read_text())==row['request'],'Frozen actual request differs')
    return external['receipt']


def validate_arm(report,row,preparation,launch,terminal,console,report_path=None):
    # Same clear native coastal Workload producer and complete command, NOT an
    # FXAA option-map assumption: exact maps are qualified by this frozen prep.
    require(row.get('scene')=='coastalwater'and row.get('command')==prep.command(row['profile'])==shared.prep.command(row['profile']),
        'Common clear coastal Workload recipe differs')
    for name in ('input_state_start','input_state_end'):
        state=report.get(name,{})
        require(all(type(state.get(k))in(int,float)and state[k]==0 for k in ('rain','thunder')),
            'Actual clear-weather rain/thunder boundary differs')
    for name in ('shader_temporal_inputs_start','shader_temporal_inputs_end'):
        value=report.get(name,{}).get('rain_strength_source')
        require(type(value)in(int,float)and value==0,'Actual clear rainStrength CPU source differs/missing')
    result=shared.validate_arm(report,row,preparation,launch,terminal,console,report_path)
    require(result['status']==shared.PASS,'Shared actual producer components unqualified')
    result['status']=PASS

def screen(frame_ms,gpu_ms):
    require(len(frame_ms)==len(gpu_ms)==3 and all(type(v)in(int,float)and math.isfinite(v)and v>0 for v in (*frame_ms,*gpu_ms)),
        'Need three positive finite actual original/candidate metrics')
    drift=dict(frame=frame_ms[2]/frame_ms[0]-1,gpu=gpu_ms[2]/gpu_ms[0]-1)
    comparison=dict(fps_gain_vs_each_original=[frame_ms[i]/frame_ms[1]-1 for i in (0,2)],
        frame_reduction_vs_each_original=[1-frame_ms[1]/frame_ms[i]for i in (0,2)],
        gpu_reduction_vs_each_original=[1-gpu_ms[1]/gpu_ms[i]for i in (0,2)])
    verdict=('inconclusive-original-control-drift'if max(abs(v)for v in drift.values())>.10+1e-12 else
        'stop-no-useful-original-signal'if min(comparison['frame_reduction_vs_each_original'])<=.05+1e-12
        or min(comparison['gpu_reduction_vs_each_original'])<=0 else 'promising-stock-global-cloud-calibration-only')
    return EVIDENCE|dict(verdict=verdict,original_control_drift=drift,primary30_15_vs_each_original=comparison,
        limitation='Single native stock screen; nominal/source cell-count reduction is not observed physical GPU work, per-pass attribution or total-frame/mod gain.')


def cross_arm(arms,receipt):
    require([r.get('arm')for r in arms]==list(ORDER),'Need three qualified cloud count arms in exact order')
    reference=arms[0];maps=cloud.option_maps(reference['full_options']);settings=[]
    for row,mode in zip(arms,MODES):
        require(row.get('status')==PASS and row.get('scene')=='coastalwater'and row.get('mode')==mode,'Unqualified/mislabeled cloud count arm')
        for key in ('window_reference','loaded_mods','raw_control','source_archive_sha256'):
            require(row[key]==reference[key],'Exact cross-arm scene/controls differ: '+key)
        require(row['hardware_context']['typed']==reference['hardware_context']['typed'],'Actual typed hardware/timer payload differs')
        require(row['full_options']==maps[mode],'Full option map differs beyond H/Z primary counts')
        normalized=copy.deepcopy(row['complete_settings'])
        for base in ('shaderlod-client','shaderlod-effects-client'):normalized.pop('config/'+base+'-1.toml.bak',None)
        settings.append(normalized)
    require(all(s==settings[0]for s in settings),'Complete other live settings differ')
    return dict(screen=screen([r['frame_mean_ms']for r in arms],[r['gpu_median_ms']for r in arms]),
        artifact_compatibility=shared.artifact_compatibility(arms,receipt),
        limits='Both visible-cloud and D0 cached/reflected-sky primary paths change; no deferred1-only attribution, physical-work/passed-step claim or quality equivalence. Sparse3Hz gross screening is not general motion acceptance.')


def analyze(preparation_path,pin,preflight_path,logs,arm=None):
    state=json.loads(Path(preparation_path).read_text());receipt=qualify_frozen_preparation(state,preparation_path,pin)
    preflight=qualify_preflight(preflight_path,preparation_path,pin)
    selected=[r for r in state['launch_plan']if arm is None or r['arm']==arm];require(selected,'Unknown arm')
    result=EVIDENCE|dict(schema=1,status='FAILED',
        preparation=dict(path=str(Path(preparation_path).resolve()),sha256=pin),
        preflight=dict(path=str(Path(preflight_path).resolve()),sha256=prep.file_hash(Path(preflight_path))),
        analyzer_source_files_sha256=source_pins(),arms=[],failures=[])
    for row in selected:
        log=Path(logs)/row['arm'];paths=dict(report=Path(row['profile'])/'workload-measurement.json',
            initial=log/'initial-process.json',terminal=log/'terminal-process.json',console=log/'console.log')
        entry=dict(arm=row['arm'],raw_inputs_sha256={str(p):prep.file_hash(p)for p in paths.values()if p.is_file()})
        try:
            launch=json.loads(paths['initial'].read_text())
            require(launch.get('preparation')==str(Path(preparation_path).resolve())and launch.get('preparation_sha256')==pin,'Birth preparation provenance differs')
            require(launch['started_ns']>preflight['verified_ns'],'Standalone unused-profile preflight must precede actual birth')
            entry.update(validate_arm(json.loads(paths['report'].read_text()),row,state,launch,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict actual Workload cost qualification for original Photon's atlas bracket."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import zipfile

import prepare_photon_shadow_atlas_screen as prep
import analyze_photon_pixel_baseline as actual

ROOT=prep.ROOT
PREPARATION_SHA256='6bc3b45f178c4fc77633c8e973cd0e49ee5daa35fd17d9240b3240a53a3406ef'
RECEIPT_SHA256='d8f80b1c79ba40d25dc14c281778211e8202bb1c1c1604d9dab3e77762d0af81'
JAR_SHA256='5f84d03813de4e6f7c70d2d2c95f85a404603975d6dae2b4dc8be775778c2b03'
ORDER=('cost2048-before','cost1536','cost2048-after')
EVIDENCE=dict(performanceEvidence=False,adapter_gain=False,quality='unaccepted',motion='unverified',

def source_pins():

def qualify_frozen_preparation(state,path):
    """Check frozen entries individually; never call a five-unused-profile verifier."""
    require(prep.file_hash(Path(path))==PREPARATION_SHA256 and state.get('status')==prep.FINAL,'Exact finalized preparation differs')
    for field in ('maintained_source_files_sha256','runtime_sources_sha256'):

    require(prep.matrix.development_fingerprints()==state['development_runtime_inputs'],'Current class/resource roots differ')

    require(entry['sha256']==RECEIPT_SHA256 and prep.baseline.coverage.qualify_receipt(entry['path'],entry['sha256'])==

def timing(report):
    result=actual.timing(report)

def launch_controls(row,launch):

def boundary(report,row):
    require(report.get('input_state_start')==report.get('input_state_end'),'Complete runtime inputs changed')
    expected=row['expected'];qualified=[]
    require(report.get('effective_shader_options')==expected['expected_effective_options'] and
        report.get('effective_shader_options_sha256')==expected['expected_effective_options_sha256'],'Report full loaded option map differs')
    for name in ('input_state_start','input_state_end'):

        require(state.get('shader_pack')==expected['archive'] and state.get('shaders_in_use') is True and state.get('fallback') is False,'Selected shader/pipeline differs')
        for key,target in (('framebuffer_width',2976),('framebuffer_height',1672),('requested_chunks',24),('effective_chunks',24),('day_time',12500)):
            require(type(state.get(key)) is int and state[key]==target,'Fixed scene scalar differs: '+key)
        require(state.get('dimension')=='minecraft:overworld','Wrong dimension')
        for key,target in (('x',500.5),('y',68),('z',660.5),('yaw',87.38),('pitch',3.735),('rain',0),('thunder',0)):
            value=state.get(key); require(type(value) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(value) and abs(value-target)<=.002,'Camera/weather differs: '+key)
        require(state.get('lod_settings')==dict(enabled=True,near=32.0,far=96.0,transition=8.0,debug=False)

        decoded=prep.qualify_configuration(state.get('configuration_files',{}),row)

        require(decoded['settings']['config/shaderlod-effects-client.toml']==row['prepared_writable_inventory']['settings']['config/shaderlod-effects-client.toml'], 'Complete effects controls differ')
        for key,value in state.items():
            if key.startswith('config/') and key.endswith('_sha256'):
                require(state['configuration_files']['files'].get(key[:-7],{}).get('sha256')==value,'Raw config alias hash differs')

    manifest=report.get('workload-manifest.json',{});prep.validate_arm_manifest(manifest)
    require(members==manifest['source_qualification']['complete_member_sha256'],'All original archive member hashes differ')
    require(manifest['shadow_resolution']==row['shadow_resolution'] and

def validate_arm(report,row,preparation,launch,console_text,report_path=None):
    require(report.get('schema')==2 and report.get('request')==row['request'],'Actual Workload schema/request differs')
    require(row['request'].get('gpu_queries') is True and row['request'].get('cpu_timing') is True,'Cost timing request differs')

def expected_archive(row):

def cross_arm(arms):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the private, fixed 0.85 Bliss native-TAAU pilot; never edit a profile.

This is an explicit archive/member-pinned adapter, not a general shader rewriter.
Assembly and source preprocessing do not certify Iris rendering or performance.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MANIFEST = ROOT / "patches/bliss-experiments/native-raster-r1.json"
BASE = ROOT / "dev/prism-testing-r1/staging/packs/bliss-shader/shaderpacks/Bliss_v2.1.2_(Chocapic13_Shaders_edit).zip"
OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT / "dev/logs/mechanism-evaluation-r1/raster"
BASE_SHA256 = "f41db92acc585fe9ffe0cc124d6ecaea27cef9ded91129ebc2a8e60226947b2c"
MANIFEST_SHA256 = "b7f6a52c57943ae142137b8f35e0e1be52795051f0ebea7d7a633c6c9e66acc7"
OPTION = "SHADERLOD_BLISS_RASTER"
FIXED_SCALE = 0.85
SCALE_VALUES = {round(i / 100, 2) for i in range(10, 101, 5)}


def sha256(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def read_members(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        entries = archive.infolist()
        names = [e.filename for e in entries]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or any(
            PurePosixPath(n).is_absolute() or ".." in PurePosixPath(n).parts
            or "\\" in n or "\x00" in n for n in names
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unsafe or duplicate archive member")
        return {e.filename: archive.read(e) for e in entries if not e.is_dir()}


def read_manifest():
    raw = MANIFEST.read_bytes()
    if sha256(raw) != MANIFEST_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Unreviewed manifest; exact pinned contract required")
    manifest = json.loads(raw)
    if (manifest["base_sha256"] != BASE_SHA256 or manifest["fixed_linear_scale"] != FIXED_SCALE
            or manifest["option_key"] != OPTION or not manifest["private_only"]):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected private candidate contract")
    return manifest


def patch(files, manifest):
    """Fail before mutation if any certified member or literal anchor changed."""
    for name, digest in (manifest["source_members"] | manifest["license_members"]).items():
        if name not in files or sha256(files[name]) != digest:
            raise ValueError("Pinned source member changed: " + name)
    result = dict(files)
    for entry in manifest["patches"]:
        name = entry["path"]
        source = files[name]
        if sha256(source) != entry["source_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Pinned patch member changed: " + name)
        for replacement in entry["replacements"]:
            before = replacement["before"].encode()
            after = replacement["after"].encode()
            if not before or source.count(before) != replacement["count"]:
                raise ValueError("Missing or ambiguous native anchor: " + name)
            source = source.replace(before, after)
        if sha256(source) != entry["patched_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Patched member hash mismatch: " + name)
        result[name] = source
    return result


def parse_options(raw):
    """Accept an explicit simple Iris override file; preserve its bytes verbatim."""
    values = {}
    for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith(("#", "!")):
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)\s*=\s*([^\s\\]+)", line)
        if not match or match[1] in values:
            raise ValueError("Ambiguous/unsupported Iris option syntax or duplicate key")
        values[match[1]] = match[2]
    if any(k.startswith("SHADERLOD_") for k in values):
        raise ValueError("Use original native options, not another ShaderLOD derivative")
    return values


def option_bool(values, name, default):
    value = values.get(name, "true" if default else "false")
    if value not in {"true", "false"}:
        raise ValueError("Expected native boolean for " + name)
    return value == "true"


def policy(values, enabled=True):
    taa = option_bool(values, "TAA", True)
    taau = option_bool(values, "TAA_UPSCALING", False)
    screenshot = option_bool(values, "SCREENSHOT_MODE", False)
    try:
        scale = float(values.get("SCALE_FACTOR", "0.75"))
        sky = int(values.get("RESOURCEPACK_SKY", "0"))
        dof = int(values.get("DOF_QUALITY", "-1"))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError("Invalid native scale/sky/DOF option") from exc
    if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale not in SCALE_VALUES:
        raise ValueError("SCALE_FACTOR is outside the pinned native choices")
    if sky not in range(4) or dof not in range(-1, 6):
        raise ValueError("Sky/DOF is outside the pinned native choices")
    native = scale if taa and taau else 1.0
    eligible = taa and not screenshot and sky == 0 and dof != 5
    effective = min(native, FIXED_SCALE) if enabled and eligible else native
    return {"native_taa": taa, "native_taau": taau, "native_scale_option": scale,
            "native_effective_scale": native, "source_option_eligible": eligible,
            "candidate_effective_scale": effective, "private_switch": int(enabled),
            "avoids_additional_nominal_area": effective < native,
            "runtime_guard_required": ["defined IRIS_VERSION == 10812", "defined MC_VERSION == 12101", "rainStrength == 0", "VOXY absent", "actual loaded native options match", "actual shader/resource/coverage joins"],
            "interpretation": "Source policy only; full target allocation and several passes remain full size"}


def build(base, options, output):
    base, options, output = Path(base).resolve(), Path(options).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    sidecar, receipt = Path(str(output) + ".txt"), output.with_suffix(".json")
    destinations = (output, sidecar, receipt)
    if (output.suffix != ".zip" or not output.is_relative_to(OUTPUT_ROOT.resolve())
            or any(p.exists() for p in destinations)
            or any(p in {base, options, MANIFEST.resolve()} for p in destinations)):
        raise ValueError("Use a fresh ZIP under the ignored raster evidence directory")
    if sha256(base.read_bytes()) != BASE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Pinned original Bliss archive mismatch")
    manifest = read_manifest()
    native_options = options.read_bytes()
    native_values = parse_options(native_options)
    effective = policy(native_values)
    if (option_bool(native_values, "SCREENSHOT_MODE", False)
            or int(native_values.get("RESOURCEPACK_SKY", "0")) != 0
            or int(native_values.get("DOF_QUALITY", "-1")) == 5):
        raise ValueError("Unqualified screenshot/custom-sky/focus-laser path; retain original")
    original = read_members(base)
    candidate = patch(original, manifest)
    candidate_options = native_options + (b"" if not native_options or native_options.endswith(b"\n") else b"\n") + (OPTION + "=1\n").encode()
    metadata = {
        "experiment": manifest["experiment"], "private_only": True,
        "base_path": str(base), "base_sha256": BASE_SHA256,
        "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA256, "builder_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),

    'shaders/lib/lighting/forwardLighting.glsl': '21687dd916c69c8bcd557e4b1bde367d7eeb77be01be1efc0b7e0ff20109fae8',
    'shaders/world0/gbuffers_terrain.fsh': 'fb8bd36225c0b74ab5befc33f7097e02e10196a20d3441a93819729792580801',
    'shaders/shaders.properties': '8856162fcf6846e1b56f5c092e6eaee04af687875f85e87cde87e1bd0a0d3169',
}
OFFSETS = ((0, 0), (0, 1), (.7, .7), (1, 0), (.7, -.7), (0, -1), (-.7, -.7), (-1, 0), (-.7, .7))

    'completed_current_frame_generation')


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def canonical(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()


def once(raw, before, after):
    if raw.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Missing/ambiguous exact source anchor')
    return raw.replace(before, after, 1)


def apply_cue(files):
    for name, expected in PINNED.items():
        if digest(files[name]) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed pinned member: ' + name)
    result = dict(files)
    include = b'#include "/lib/lighting/forwardLighting.glsl"'
    result[TERRAIN] = once(result[TERRAIN], include,
        b'#define SHADERLOD_BSL_TILES_SCOPE()\r\n#include "/lib/shaderlod/bsl_tiles_census_r1.glsl"\r\n' + include)
    entry = b'vec3 SampleFilteredShadow(vec3 shadowPos, float offset, float subsurface) {\r\n'
    result[SHADOWS] = once(result[SHADOWS], entry, entry +
        b'    #ifdef SHADERLOD_BSL_TILES_SCOPE\r\n    shaderlodBslTilesObserve(shadowPos, offset, subsurface);\r\n    #endif\r\n')
    write = b'    gl_FragData[0] = albedo;'
    result[TERRAIN] = once(result[TERRAIN], write, write +
        b'\r\n    // Diagnostic override after ALL native lighting; no sampling is bypassed.\r\n'
        b'    if (shaderlodBslTilesCensusEnabled()) gl_FragData[0] = shaderlodBslTilesRecord;')
    # Iris parses pack constants inside this native declaration comment too.
    # Root must certify the actually allocated format; source alone is not proof.
    result[FINAL] = once(result[FINAL], b'const int colortex0Format = R11F_G11F_B10F;',
        b'const int colortex0Format = RGBA32F;')
    result[HELPER] = (ROOT / 'patches/bsl-shadow-tiles-r1/census.glsl').read_bytes()
    return result


def build(output):
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    sidecar, receipt = Path(str(output) + '.txt'), output.with_suffix('.json')
    if output.suffix != '.zip' or not output.is_relative_to(OUT.resolve()) or any(p.exists() for p in (output, sidecar, receipt)):
        raise ValueError('Use fresh ZIP under ignored owned output directory')
    if digest(BASE.read_bytes()) != ARCHIVE_SHA or digest(IRIS.read_bytes()) != IRIS_SHA or digest(CAPTURE.read_bytes()) != CAPTURE_SHA:
        raise ValueError('Unqualified original archive/Iris/runtime certificate')
    cert = json.loads(CAPTURE.read_bytes())
    options = cert['loadedIrisOptions']
    if len(options) != 384 or digest(canonical(options)) != OPTIONS_MAP_SHA or cert['irisFallback'] or not cert['shaderPackInUse']:
        raise ValueError('Unqualified original option certificate')
    if OPTIONS.read_bytes() != b'':
        raise ValueError('Pinned original sidecar changed')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BASE) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or any(PurePosixPath(n).is_absolute() or '..' in PurePosixPath(n).parts or '\\' in n or '\x00' in n for n in names):
            raise ValueError('Unsafe/duplicate archive member')
        original = {n: archive.read(n) for n in names if not n.endswith('/')}
    files = apply_cue(original)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'x', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for name, raw in sorted(files.items()):
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
            archive.writestr(info, raw)
    sidecar.write_bytes(OPTIONS.read_bytes())
    result = {'kind': 'BSL-B4-private-coordinate-census-only', 'never_time': True,
        'builder_sha256': digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        'archive_sha256': digest(output.read_bytes()), 'original_archive_sha256': ARCHIVE_SHA,
        'iris_sha256': IRIS_SHA, 'original_capture_sha256': CAPTURE_SHA,
        'original_loaded_options_map_sha256': OPTIONS_MAP_SHA,
        'original_member_sha256': {n: digest(raw) for n, raw in original.items()},
        'modified_members': sorted(n for n in original if files[n] != original[n]),
        'added_members': [HELPER], 'cue_member_sha256': {n: digest(files[n]) for n in (TERRAIN, SHADOWS, FINAL, HELPER)},
        'unchanged_properties_sha256': digest(files['shaders/shaders.properties']),
        'license': 'LicenseRef-All-Rights-Reserved; personal local diagnostic only; do not redistribute',
        'options_actually_loaded': False, 'driver_compiled': False, 'runtime_census': False,
        'performance_acceptance': False, 'restoration': 'Reload exact original archive and empty native sidecar; cue Off retains diagnostic allocation and is not a cost baseline'}
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    return result


def support_tiles(u, v, radius, width, height, uv_error=0.0):
    """Rectangular bilinear support superset, expanded for measured UV error.

    Normalized UV/radius -> PHYSICAL texels, with center at texel+0.5.
    Unknown border is ineligible. The tile field covers complete 4x4 tiles.
    """
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (u, v, radius, uv_error)) or radius < 0 or uv_error < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid support coordinates/error')
    lo_x = math.floor((u - radius - uv_error) * width - .5)
    hi_x = math.floor((u + radius + uv_error) * width - .5) + 1
    lo_y = math.floor((v - radius - uv_error) * height - .5)
    hi_y = math.floor((v + radius + uv_error) * height - .5) + 1
    if lo_x < 0 or lo_y < 0 or hi_x >= width or hi_y >= height:
        return None
    tiles = {(x, y) for x in range(lo_x // 4, hi_x // 4 + 1) for y in range(lo_y // 4, hi_y // 4 + 1)}
    # Full tile minima, not four probes and not merely the nine-point union.
    if any(4*x + 3 >= width or 4*y + 3 >= height for x, y in tiles):
        return None
    return tiles


def all_lit(depth, width, tiles, reference, reference_error, compare_margin):
    if tiles is None:
        return False
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (reference, reference_error, compare_margin)) or reference_error < 0 or compare_margin < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid comparison/error bound')
    threshold = reference + reference_error + compare_margin
    # Strictly greater avoids relying on equality/unknown conversion rounding.
    return all(math.isfinite(depth[(ty*4+dy)*width + tx*4+dx]) and
               depth[(ty*4+dy)*width + tx*4+dx] > threshold
               for tx, ty in tiles for dy in range(4) for dx in range(4))


def coordinate_records(raw, extent):
    """One visible surviving sample per unfiltered RGBA32F terrain texel.

    Clears and other programs can overwrite the image. Root MUST qualify exact
    terrain-only capture and clear sentinel; no screen image proves overdraw.
    """
    if len(raw) != math.prod(extent) * 16:
        raise ValueError('Coordinate hash/extent mismatch')
    coordinates = array('f'); coordinates.frombytes(raw)
    if sys.byteorder != 'little':
        coordinates.byteswap()
    for i in range(0, len(coordinates), 4):
        u, v, reference, radius = coordinates[i:i+4]
        yield {'multiplicity': 1, 'subsurface': 0 if radius > 0 else 1,
               'filtered_reached': radius > 0, 'offset': radius,
               'shadow_position': (u, v, reference)}


def expression_screen(width, height, pixels, eligible, hits, query_count):
    """Investment screen only: raw reads and hardware PCF are unequal-cost."""
    if pixels <= 0 or eligible < 0 or not 0 <= hits <= eligible or query_count < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid cost denominator')
    build_reads = 16 * math.ceil(width / 4) * math.ceil(height / 4)
    baseline = 9 * eligible
    candidate = build_reads + query_count + 9 * (eligible - hits)
    return {'p_invocations_per_output_pixel': eligible / pixels,
        'h_all_lit_fraction': hits / eligible if eligible else 0,
        'build_raw_fetch_expressions': build_reads, 'query_fetch_expressions': query_count,
        'native_primary_fetch_expressions': baseline, 'candidate_primary_fetch_expressions': candidate,
        'optimistic_expression_screen_pass': candidate < baseline,
        'useful_r32f_bytes': 4 * math.ceil(width/4) * math.ceil(height/4),
        'iris_full_r32f_bytes_per_image': 4 * width * height,
        'iris_full_r32f_bytes_two_images': 8 * width * height,
        'performance_claim': False}


def analyze(snapshot):
    """Analyze root-supplied same-epoch exact records; never invent measurements.

    Binary depth file is GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT/GL_FLOAT little endian. A visible
    coordinate image must be converted to records BEFORE ANY deferred/composite
    stage, with explicit surviving-sample population, not total invocations.
    """
    snapshot = Path(snapshot)
    data = json.loads(snapshot.read_bytes())
    if data['original_archive_sha256'] != ARCHIVE_SHA or data['iris_sha256'] != IRIS_SHA or data['options_map_sha256'] != OPTIONS_MAP_SHA:
        raise ValueError('Unqualified original snapshot provenance')
    cue_receipt_raw = (snapshot.parent / data['cue_receipt_file']).read_bytes()
    cue_receipt = json.loads(cue_receipt_raw)
    if (digest(cue_receipt_raw) != data['cue_receipt_sha256'] or
        cue_receipt['archive_sha256'] != data['capture_archive_sha256'] or
        cue_receipt['original_archive_sha256'] != ARCHIVE_SHA or
        not cue_receipt['never_time'] or not data['native_shadow_source_and_state_unchanged_verified']):
        raise ValueError('Unjoined cue capture archive/native shadow contract')
    if data['population'] not in ('visible-selected-terrain', 'complete-forward-invocations'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown invocation population')
    if data['depth_epoch'] != data['receivers_epoch'] or not data['epoch_complete']:
        raise ValueError('Not one completed current shadow epoch')
    epoch = data['producer_epoch']
    if (set(epoch) != set(EPOCH_DOMAINS) or any(not epoch[key] for key in EPOCH_DOMAINS) or
        data['depth_epoch'] != digest(canonical(epoch))):
        raise ValueError('Incomplete current producer epoch domains/digest')
    if data['compare_func'] != 'LEQUAL' or data['compare_mode'] != 'COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE' or data['filter'] != 'LINEAR' or data['depth_level'] != 0:
        raise ValueError('Unqualified native comparison/filter support')
    if data['sampler_bounds_verified'] is not True or data['raw_readback_verified'] is not True:
        raise ValueError('Unverified sampler/readback bounds')
    width, height = data['physical_depth_extent']
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid physical extent')
    raw_path = snapshot.parent / data['depth_f32le_file']
    raw = raw_path.read_bytes()
    if digest(raw) != data['depth_sha256'] or len(raw) != width * height * 4:
        raise ValueError('Depth hash/extent mismatch')
    depth = array('f'); depth.frombytes(raw)
    if sys.byteorder != 'little':
        depth.byteswap()
    eligible = hits = query_count = excluded = 0
    if 'coordinates_rgba32f_file' in data:
        if data['population'] != 'visible-selected-terrain' or not data['terrain_only_image_and_clear_verified']:
            raise ValueError('Image is not a complete invocation census')
        coordinates_raw = (snapshot.parent / data['coordinates_rgba32f_file']).read_bytes()
        if digest(coordinates_raw) != data['coordinates_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Coordinate hash mismatch')
        records = coordinate_records(coordinates_raw, data['output_extent'])
    else:
        records = data['records']
    tile_minima = {}
    for record in records:
        weight = record['multiplicity']
        if type(weight) is not int or weight <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Invalid invocation multiplicity')
        if record['subsurface'] != 0 or not record['filtered_reached'] or record['offset'] != 1 / data['declared_resolution']:
            excluded += weight; continue
        u, v, reference = record['shadow_position']
        if not math.isfinite(reference) or not 0 <= reference <= 1:
            excluded += weight; continue
        tiles = support_tiles(u, v, record['offset'], width, height, data['uv_error_bound'])
        # Fixed-four candidate must FALL BACK before query at larger supports.
        if tiles is None or len(tiles) > 4:
            excluded += weight; continue
        eligible += weight
        query_count += len(tiles) * weight
        for tile in tiles:
            if tile not in tile_minima:
                tx, ty = tile
                values = [depth[(ty*4+dy)*width + tx*4+dx] for dy in range(4) for dx in range(4)]
                tile_minima[tile] = min(values) if all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values) else -math.inf
        error, margin = data['reference_error_bound'], data['compare_margin']
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0 for x in (error, margin)):
            raise ValueError('Invalid comparison/error bound')
        hits += weight * all(tile_minima[tile] > reference + error + margin for tile in tiles)
    result = expression_screen(width, height, math.prod(data['output_extent']), eligible, hits, query_count)
    result.update({'snapshot_sha256': digest(snapshot.read_bytes()), 'depth_sha256': digest(raw),
        'eligible_invocations': eligible, 'all_lit_invocations': hits, 'excluded_native_invocations': excluded,
        'population': data['population'], 'whole_forward_expression_screen_pass': data['population'] == 'complete-forward-invocations' and result['optimistic_expression_screen_pass'],
        'runtime_provenance_independently_verified': False,
        'caveat': 'Structural snapshot checks do not prove hook completeness, actual invocation capture, derivatives, driver arithmetic or GPU cost. Visible subset cannot reject/admit whole-forward candidate.'})
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    group.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
    group.add_argument('--snapshot', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = build(args.output) if args.output else analyze(args.snapshot)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pinned BSL10.1.8/native384 private zero-emission arithmetic control/candidate."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASE = ROOT / 'dev/upstream/other-pack-research/BSL_v10.1.8.zip'
BASE_SHA = '36b0a50ff7918bf10e9422c401d93779f9d0088a26acea975b435243f96930b5'
OPTIONS = ROOT / 'src/main/resources/assets/shaderlod/bslquad/native384.json'
OPTIONS_SHA = '0aaa1276ea6e24106e6ed062a3bd149d1b53c09693d04a4637dcb19e6c43c394'
OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT / 'dev/logs/speed-port-r1/12111-fabric-bsl-zero-emission-20261011'
ENTRY = 'shaders/world0/gbuffers_terrain.fsh'
TERRAIN = 'shaders/program/gbuffers_terrain.glsl'
PRIVATE = 'shaders/shaderlod/bsl_zero_emission_r1/'
ENTRY_SHA = 'fb8bd36225c0b74ab5befc33f7097e02e10196a20d3441a93819729792580801'
TERRAIN_SHA = 'c47d350132261e8f7b271f99ba8d060e4b38ee12a5da50597b664245f212c8d7'
DECLARATIONS = (b'uniform bool shaderlodBslZeroEmissionEnabled;\r\n'
                b'uniform int shaderlodBslZeroEmissionVersion;\r\n'
                b'uniform int shaderlodBslZeroEmissionPreset;\r\n')
NATIVE_ARITHMETIC = (b'\t\tvec3 hsv = RGB2HSV(albedo.rgb);\r\n'
                     b'\t\temission *= GetHardcodedEmission(albedo.rgb, hsv);')
SKIP_HELPER = (
    b'bool shaderlodBslZeroEmissionSkip(float nativeEmission, vec3 nativeRgb) {\r\n'
    b'    return shaderlodBslZeroEmissionEnabled && shaderlodBslZeroEmissionVersion == 1 &&\r\n'
    b'           shaderlodBslZeroEmissionPreset == 1 && nativeEmission == 0.0 &&\r\n'
    b'           all(greaterThanEqual(nativeRgb, vec3(0.0))) &&\r\n'
    b'           all(lessThanEqual(nativeRgb, vec3(2.0)));\r\n'
    b'}\r\n')
# Exact emission equality, fixed arithmetic safety domain, and actual mod bridge.
CANDIDATE_ARITHMETIC = (
    b'\t\t#if !defined(ADVANCED_MATERIALS) && !defined(GLOWING_ORES) && EMISSIVE_HARDCODED == 0\r\n'
    b'\t\tif (!shaderlodBslZeroEmissionSkip(emission, albedo.rgb)) {\r\n'
    b'\t\t\tvec3 hsv = RGB2HSV(albedo.rgb);\r\n'
    b'\t\t\temission *= GetHardcodedEmission(albedo.rgb, hsv);\r\n'
    b'\t\t}\r\n'
    b'\t\t#else\r\n' + NATIVE_ARITHMETIC + b'\r\n'
    b'\t\t#endif')
NOTICE = (b'Private ShaderLOD zero-emission arithmetic experiment derived from BSL Shaders v10 Series\n'
          b'by Capt Tatsu, https://capttatsu.com . All original source credits and license terms retained.\n'
          b'Native384 source only; no shader-quality, driver or performance acceptance implied.\n')

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def replace_once(source, before, after):
    if source.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Missing or ambiguous pinned source anchor: ' + repr(before[:100]))
    return source.replace(before, after, 1)

def load(base=BASE, options=OPTIONS):
    if sha(Path(base).read_bytes()) != BASE_SHA or sha(Path(options).read_bytes()) != OPTIONS_SHA:
        raise ValueError('Pinned original archive/native384 resource mismatch')
    values = json.loads(Path(options).read_bytes())
    if len(values) != 384 or values.get('ADVANCED_MATERIALS') != 'false' or values.get('GLOWING_ORES') != 'false' or values.get('EMISSIVE_HARDCODED') != '0':
        raise ValueError('Unsupported native emission graph')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(base) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or any(PurePosixPath(n).is_absolute() or '..' in PurePosixPath(n).parts or '\\' in n or '\x00' in n for n in names):
            raise ValueError('Unsafe or duplicate archive inventory')
        files = {n: archive.read(n) for n in names if not n.endswith('/')}
    if sha(files.get(ENTRY, b'')) != ENTRY_SHA or sha(files.get(TERRAIN, b'')) != TERRAIN_SHA:
        raise ValueError('Pinned BSL terrain entry/body changed')
    return files

def derive(original, candidate):
    if sha(original.get(ENTRY, b'')) != ENTRY_SHA or sha(original.get(TERRAIN, b'')) != TERRAIN_SHA:
        raise ValueError('Uncertified terrain entry/body')
    result = dict(original)
    terrain = replace_once(original[TERRAIN], b'uniform int bedrockLevel;', DECLARATIONS + b'uniform int bedrockLevel;')
    if terrain.count(NATIVE_ARITHMETIC) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native HSV/arithmetic sequence changed')
    if candidate:
        terrain = replace_once(terrain, b'uniform int bedrockLevel;', SKIP_HELPER + b'uniform int bedrockLevel;')
        terrain = replace_once(terrain, NATIVE_ARITHMETIC, CANDIDATE_ARITHMETIC)
    # Control is the native expression: unused protocol uniforms may be pruned; no artificial work.
    result[ENTRY] = replace_once(original[ENTRY], b'#include "/program/gbuffers_terrain.glsl"', b'#include "/shaderlod/bsl_zero_emission_r1/terrain.glsl"')
    if any(n in original for n in (PRIVATE + 'terrain.glsl', PRIVATE + 'NOTICE')):
        raise ValueError('Private namespace already occupied')
    result[PRIVATE + 'terrain.glsl'] = terrain
    result[PRIVATE + 'NOTICE'] = NOTICE
    if [n for n in original if result[n] != original[n]] != [ENTRY]:
        raise ValueError('Only world0 terrain fragment entry may change')
    return result

def archive_bytes(files):
    memory = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(memory, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as archive:
        for name, data in sorted(files.items()):
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            info.create_system = 3
            info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
            archive.writestr(info, data, compresslevel=9)
    return memory.getvalue()

def build(output, base=BASE, options=OPTIONS):
    destination = Path(output).absolute()
    for parent in (destination, *destination.parents):
        if parent.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('Output path aliases another location')
    destination = destination.resolve()
    if not destination.is_relative_to(OUTPUT_ROOT.resolve()) or destination == OUTPUT_ROOT.resolve() or destination.exists():
        raise ValueError('Fresh child output directory under the named ignored experiment is required')
    original = load(base, options)
    arms = {arm: derive(original, candidate) for arm, candidate in [('control', False), ('candidate', True)]}
    data = {arm: archive_bytes(files) for arm, files in arms.items()}
    record = {'kind': 'private-bsl-native384-zero-emission-r1', 'base_path': str(Path(base).resolve()),
              'base_sha256': BASE_SHA, 'native384_sha256': OPTIONS_SHA,
              'builder_sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), 'runtime_accepted': False,
              'quality_accepted': False, 'performance_accepted': False, 'arms': {}}
    destination.mkdir(parents=True)
    for arm, files in arms.items():
        path = destination / ('BSL-zero-emission-r1-' + arm + '.zip')
        with path.open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(data[arm])
        with Path(str(path) + '.txt').open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(b'')  # Zero overrides, never an empty effective options map.
        record['arms'][arm] = {'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(data[arm]),
            'sidecar_sha256': sha(b''), 'modified_original_members': [ENTRY],
            'added_members': [PRIVATE + 'NOTICE', PRIVATE + 'terrain.glsl'],
            'member_sha256': {n: sha(b) for n, b in sorted(files.items())},
            'control_unused_uniforms_may_be_pruned': arm == 'control'}
    with (destination / 'manifest.json').open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    return record

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--base', default=BASE, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--options', default=OPTIONS, type=Path)
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(build(arguments.output, arguments.base, arguments.options), indent=2))

def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
 return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def dimensions(width: int, height: int) -> list[tuple[int,int]]:
 if width < 1 or height < 1:
  raise ValueError('positive dimensions required')
 levels = [(width,height)]
 while levels[-1] != (1,1):
  w,h = levels[-1]
  levels.append(((w+1)//2,(h+1)//2))
 return levels

def atlas_plan(width: int, height: int) -> dict:
 """Two parity atlases; largest tile left, remaining tiles stacked to its right.

 Separate source and output texture objects prevent raster feedback. Ceil
 reduction includes every odd edge; this is an atlas, not a GL mip chain.
 """
 levels = dimensions(width,height)
 atlases=[]
 for parity in (0,1):
  assigned=[(i,w,h) for i,(w,h) in enumerate(levels) if i%2==parity]
  if not assigned:
   atlases.append({'width':0,'height':0,'bytes':0,'tiles':[]})
   continue
  first, *tail = assigned
  _,w0,h0=first
  aw=w0 + max((w for _,w,_ in tail),default=0)
  ah=max(h0,sum(h for _,_,h in tail))
  tiles=[{'level':first[0],'x':0,'y':0,'width':w0,'height':h0}]
  y=0
  for i,w,h in tail:
   tiles.append({'level':i,'x':w0,'y':y,'width':w,'height':h})
   y+=h
  atlases.append({'width':aw,'height':ah,'bytes':aw*ah*8,'tiles':tiles})
 n=width*height
 output_cells=sum(w*h for w,h in levels)
 reduction_cells=output_cells-n
 # Actual child count, excluding absent padded children: each prior-level cell
 # is read exactly once by its parent. Four fetch expressions per parent if
 # implementation clamps absent children instead; budget that higher value.
 actual_child_reads=sum(w*h for w,h in levels[:-1])
 return {'width':width,'height':height,'levels':levels,'draws_per_domain':len(levels),
  'atlases':atlases,'allocated_bytes':sum(a['bytes'] for a in atlases),
  'logical_bytes':output_cells*8,'base_depth_reads':n,
  'reduction_child_reads':actual_child_reads,'reduction_fetch_upper':4*reduction_cells,
  'output_cells':output_cells,'minimum_traffic_bytes':n*4+actual_child_reads*8+output_cells*8,
  'consumer_sampler_groups':2,'producer_source_sampler_groups':1,
  'consumer_reads_branches_and_native_fallback':'not included; depend on actual traversal/coverage',
  'full_rebuild_each_frame':True}

def conservative_pyramid(grid: list[list[float]]) -> list[list[list[tuple[float,float]]]]:
 """CPU reference only: raw scalar min/max, no projection or shader acceptance.

 Unknown/nonfinite/out-of-range normalized depths are [0,1], never empty.
 Copying finite source float32 endpoints does not introduce depth arithmetic.
 """
 if not grid or not grid[0] or any(len(r)!=len(grid[0]) for r in grid):
  raise ValueError('nonempty rectangular grid required')
 levels=[[[ (v,v) if math.isfinite(v) and 0<=v<=1 else (0.,1.) for v in row] for row in grid]]
 while len(levels[-1])>1 or len(levels[-1][0])>1:
  src=levels[-1]; h=len(src); w=len(src[0]); dst=[]
  for y in range(0,h,2):
   row=[]
   for x in range(0,w,2):
    children=[src[cy][cx] for cy in range(y,min(y+2,h)) for cx in range(x,min(x+2,w))]
    row.append((min(v[0] for v in children),max(v[1] for v in children)))
   dst.append(row)
  levels.append(dst)
 return levels

def excludes_native_interval(bound: tuple[float,float], interval: tuple[float,float]) -> bool:
 """Inclusive overlap test: equality/unknown/invalid values retain native work."""
 lo,hi=bound; a,b=interval
 if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (lo,hi,a,b)) or lo>hi or a>b:
  return False
 return hi<a or lo>b

def ssr_z_exclusion_math(z_ray: float, z_bounds: tuple[float,float], thickness: float) -> bool:
 """Real-arithmetic necessary Euclidean-hit condition, NOT a GPU certificate.

 Reversed/NaN/invalid bounds retain native work. Metadata still needs the
 terminal native sample. Runtime projection/filter/error bounds are absent.
 """
 lo,hi=z_bounds
 if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (z_ray,lo,hi,thickness)) or lo>hi or thickness<0:
  return False
 separation=max(lo-z_ray,z_ray-hi,0.)
 return separation>thickness

def sampler_closure(z: zipfile.ZipFile, index: dict[str,str], entry: str) -> dict:
 """Lexical include closure across all conditions; not linked active uniforms."""
 seen=set(); samplers=set(); members=[]
 def visit(path: str):
  if path in seen: return
  seen.add(path); data=z.read(index[path])
  code=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*','',data.decode('utf-8'),flags=re.S)
  extracted=ROOT/'dev/logs/generic-lod-strategy-r1/geometry/sources/solas-shader/shaders'/path
  if extracted.read_bytes()!=data: raise ValueError('include closure extract mismatch: '+path)
  members.append({'member':index[path],'canonical':path,'sha256':sha(data)})
  for declaration in re.finditer(r'\buniform\s+sampler\w+\s+([^;]+);',code):
   samplers.update(name.strip() for name in declaration.group(1).split(','))
  for included in re.findall(r'#include\s+"/([^\"]+)"',code): visit(included)
 visit(entry)
 return {'entry':entry,'members':sorted(members,key=lambda v:v['canonical']),
  'all_conditional_sampler_names':sorted(samplers),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pinned private G01: one-pixel native R16F history and R32F current transfer.

A 1x1 producer computes the exact native exposure before native composite0,
writing its unrounded FP32 value and normal rounded R16F history. Composite0
reads the FP32 transfer for current color. No RT1 flip or mip-count changes.
A separate untimed build retains independent native RT6 history/arithmetic for
same-frame comparison. All runtime economics/correctness remain experimental.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from build_makeup_unused_sky import read_archive, archive_bytes, once, sha, NATIVE

SCALAR='SHADERLOD_G01_SCALAR_EXPOSURE'
COPIES='SHADERLOD_G01_COPY_FLIPS'
OPTIONS='shaders/lib/g01/options.glsl'
PROPS='shaders/shaders.properties'
BASE=f'defined IS_IRIS && IRIS_VERSION == 10812 && MC_VERSION == 12101 && defined MC_OS_MAC && !defined DISTANT_HORIZONS && !defined VOXY && !defined VOXY_PATCH'
ACTIVE=f'{SCALAR} >= 1 && {SCALAR} <= 2 && {BASE}'
COPY_ACTIVE=f'{COPIES} >= 1 && {COPIES} <= 2 && {BASE}'

def route(native,on):
    # Each branch keeps its own native program macros before including config.
    # New options live in a separate header: native config contains GLSL consts
    # and cannot safely be included twice just to decide a route.
    def body(s):
        lines=s.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
        return ''.join(l for l in lines if not l.startswith(('#version','#extension')))
    return ('#version 120\n#extension GL_ARB_shader_texture_lod : enable\n'
            '#include "/lib/g01/options.glsl"\n#if '+ACTIVE+'\n'+body(on)+
            '\n#else\n'+body(native)+'\n#endif\n').encode()

def patch(native,diagnostic=False):
    files=dict(native)
    files[OPTIONS]=(f'// Private G01 exact exposure scheduling and dead-copy controls.\n#define {SCALAR} 0 // [0 1 2]\n#define {COPIES} 0 // [0 1 2]\n').encode()
    def clone(name,text):
        out='shaders/lib/g01/'+name
        if out in files:raise ValueError('Private source collision')
        files[out]=text.encode();return '/lib/g01/'+name
    def wrapper(common,macros='#define COMPOSITE_SHADER'):
        return ('#version 120\n#extension GL_ARB_shader_texture_lod : enable\n'+macros+'\n#include "'+common+'"\n').encode()
    # Before native composite0: preserve exact native arithmetic, same original
    # RT1 mip input and previous rounded history. Both outputs have one texel.
    producer_v=clone('history_vertex.glsl',native['shaders/common/composite_vertex.glsl'].decode().replace('gaux3','colortex8'))
    producer_f=clone('history_fragment.glsl','''#include "/lib/config.glsl"
/*
const int colortex8Format = R16F;
*/
/*
const int colortex9Format = R32F;
*/
const bool colortex8Clear = false;
const bool colortex9Clear = false;
const bool colortex8Nearest = true;
const bool colortex9Nearest = true;
const bool colortex1MipmapEnabled = true;
varying float exposure;
void main() {
    /* RENDERTARGETS: 8,9 */
    gl_FragData[0] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    gl_FragData[1] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
}
''')
    for suffix,producer in [('vsh',producer_v),('fsh',producer_f)]:
        n='shaders/world0/composite.'+suffix;files[n]=route(native[n],wrapper(producer))
    v=native['shaders/common/composite_vertex.glsl'].decode()
    if not diagnostic:
        start=v.index('    // Exposure\n');end=v.index('    #if (VOL_LIGHT',start)
        v=v[:start]+'    // Unrounded FP32 transfer; the history remains native R16F.\n    exposure = texture2D(colortex9, vec2(0.5)).r;\n\n'+v[end:]
        v=v.replace('uniform sampler2D gaux3;','uniform sampler2D colortex9;')
    vertex=clone('composite_vertex.glsl',v)
    f=native['shaders/common/composite_fragment.glsl'].decode()
    f=once(f,'const bool colortex1MipmapEnabled = true;\n','') # producer already generated this exact preimage
    if diagnostic:
        # Independent native previous/current R16F history remains RT6. The
        # original native vertex expression is untouched; RT10 keeps unrounded
        # output for comparison with the earlier producer's actual FP32 store.
        f=once(f,'/* DRAWBUFFERS:016 */','/* RENDERTARGETS: 0,1,6,10 */')
        f=once(f,'/* DRAWBUFFERS:16 */','/* RENDERTARGETS: 1,6,10 */')
        f=once(f,'        gl_FragData[2] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);','        gl_FragData[2] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n        gl_FragData[3] = vec4(exposure,0.0,0.0,0.0);')
        f=once(f,'        gl_FragData[1] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);','        gl_FragData[1] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n        gl_FragData[2] = vec4(exposure,0.0,0.0,0.0);')
        f+='\n/*\nconst int colortex6Format = R16F;\n*/\n/*\nconst int colortex10Format = R32F;\n*/\nconst bool colortex10Clear = false;\n'
        files['SHADERLOD_G01_EXPOSURE_DIAGNOSTIC.json']=json.dumps({'native':NATIVE,'diagnostic_only':True,'rt6':'independent native full-size R16F history','rt8':'1x1 R16F history','rt9':'1x1 R32F unrounded transfer','rt10':'independent native unrounded exposure, full-size R32F'}).encode()
    else:
        f=once(f,'/* DRAWBUFFERS:016 */','/* DRAWBUFFERS:01 */')
        f=once(f,'/* DRAWBUFFERS:16 */','/* DRAWBUFFERS:1 */')
        f=once(f,'        gl_FragData[2] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n','')
        f=once(f,'        gl_FragData[1] = vec4(exposure, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n','')
    fragment=clone('composite_fragment.glsl',f)
    for suffix,common in [('vsh',vertex),('fsh',fragment)]:
        n='shaders/world0/composite1.'+suffix;files[n]=route(native[n],wrapper(common))
        n2='shaders/world0/composite2.'+suffix;files[n2]=route(native[n2],native[n])
        n3='shaders/world0/composite3.'+suffix
        if n3 in files:raise ValueError('Native composite3 occupied')
        files[n3]=native[n2]
    for stem,stage in [('final','vertex'),('final','fragment'),('glint_blocks','vertex')]:
        old='/common/'+stem+'_'+stage+'.glsl'
        common=clone(stem+'_'+stage+'.glsl',native['shaders'+old].decode().replace('uniform sampler2D gaux3;','uniform sampler2D colortex8;').replace('texture2D(gaux3,','texture2D(colortex8,'))
        suffix='vsh' if stage=='vertex' else 'fsh'
        targets=[n for n in native if n.startswith('shaders/world0/') and n.endswith('.'+suffix) and ('"'+old+'"').encode() in native[n]]
        if len(targets)!=1:raise ValueError('Native exposure consumer census changed')
        n=targets[0];files[n]=route(native[n],native[n].replace(old.encode(),common.encode()))
    files[PROPS]+=f'''
# Private G01. Global properties receive dimension-local option macros too.
# Program activation is world0-only. Other dimensions retain original RT1 flips.
#if {ACTIVE}
program.world0/composite3.enabled=true
size.buffer.colortex8=1 1
size.buffer.colortex9=1 1
#if {SCALAR} == 2
# Non-history FP32 transfer is dead after the native composite consumer.
flip.composite1.colortex9=true
#endif
#if {COPY_ACTIVE}
flip.composite3.colortex0=true
flip.composite3.colortex7=true
#if {COPIES} == 2
# RT4 is overwritten by deferred before its only translucent consumers.
# The late flip follows all consumers and cancels its persistence copy.
flip.composite3.colortex4=true
#endif
#endif
#else
program.world0/composite3.enabled=false
#if {COPY_ACTIVE}
flip.composite2.colortex0=true
flip.composite2.colortex7=true
#if {COPIES} == 2
flip.composite2.colortex4=true
#endif
#endif
#endif
screen.SHADERLOD_G01 = {SCALAR} {COPIES}
'''.encode()
    files[PROPS]=once(files[PROPS].decode(),'screen = ','screen = [SHADERLOD_G01] ').encode()
    return files

def build(original,options,output,diagnostic=False):
    native=read_archive(original);files=patch(native,diagnostic);options=Path(options).read_bytes()
    if b'SHADERLOD_' in options:raise ValueError('Native sidecar required')
    output=Path(output);paths=[output,Path(str(output)+'.txt'),output.with_suffix('.json')]
    if any(p.exists() for p in paths):raise ValueError('Fresh output required')
    meta={'id':'G01','variant':'scalar-exposure-fp32-transfer-r6-rt4','base_sha256':NATIVE,'default_off':True,'diagnostic_only':diagnostic,'changed_native_members':[n for n in native if files[n]!=native[n]],'added_members':[n for n in files if n not in native],'scope':'Private Mac MC1.21.1 Iris1.8.12 MakeUp9.5g world0, no DH/Voxy; runtime selected native100 AA2. Other dimensions route native.','mechanism':'Omit full-resolution RT6 MRT output and persistence copy; add 1x1 R16F history/R32F current-exposure producer before native composite0. RT1 flips and mip count stay native; original current color reads unrounded FP32, final/glint/history use R16F. Optional independent RT0/RT7 dead-copy flips, with mode2 also cancelling RT4 after its translucent consumers. Native RT3 TAA history stays unchanged.','unverified':['actual native RT1 preimage mip binding and same mip count','actual full-size global viewWidth/viewHeight in 1x1 producer','R16F cold-start/resize history and final/glint consumption','whole-frame net economics, motion, DH/PBR fallback, restoration']}
    files['SHADERLOD_G01_SCALAR_NOTICE.txt']=('Private MakeUp Ultra Fast9.5g derivative, LGPL-3.0-or-later. Original licenses/ancestry retained. Additions LGPL-3.0-or-later.\n'+json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
    data=archive_bytes(files);output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);output.write_bytes(data);paths[1].write_bytes(options+(b'' if options.endswith(b'\n') else b'\n')+f'{SCALAR}=0\n{COPIES}=0\n'.encode());meta['sha256']=sha(data);meta['artifact']=str(output.resolve());paths[2].write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n');return meta
if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--original',required=True,type=Path);p.add_argument('--options',required=True,type=Path);p.add_argument('--output',required=True,type=Path);p.add_argument('--diagnostic',action='store_true');print(json.dumps(build(**vars(p.parse_args())),indent=2))

    'shaders/program/c1_blend_layers.fsh', 'shaders/shaders.properties',

    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        names = [n for n in archive.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or any(n.startswith('/') or '..' in Path(n).parts for n in names):
            raise ValueError('Duplicate or unsafe archive member')
        return {n: archive.read(n) for n in names}

def patch_members(files, manifest, arm, root=ROOT):
    if (arm not in ARMS or manifest['schema'] != 1 or
        manifest['experiment'] != 'photon-fixed-graph-air-fog-cost-ablation' or
        manifest['base_sha256'] != BASE_SHA256 or manifest['base_version'] != 'v1.3b' or
        manifest['switch'] != SWITCH or tuple(e['path'] for e in manifest['members']) != MEMBERS or
        manifest['addition']['path'] != HELPER or
        manifest['addition']['source_path'] != 'shaderpacks/photon-air-fog-cost-ablation/' + HELPER or
        tuple(manifest['source_dependencies']) != DEPENDENCIES or manifest['profile_condition'] != STAGE or

        raise ValueError('Upstream license changed')
    for name, expected in manifest['source_dependencies'].items():
        if sha256(files[name]) != expected: raise ValueError('Source dependency changed: ' + name)

    for entry in manifest['members']:
        name = entry['path']

    modified = sorted(n for n in original if original[n] != files[n])
    if modified != ([] if arm == 'original' else sorted(MEMBERS)): raise ValueError('Unexpected changes')
    metadata = {
        'experiment': manifest['experiment'], 'arm': arm, 'base_sha256': BASE_SHA256,

    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=output.parent,suffix='.zip',delete=False) as f: temporary=Path(f.name)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as archive:
            for name,payload in sorted(files.items()):
                info=zipfile.ZipInfo(name,date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0)); info.compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                info.create_system=3; info.external_attr=0o100644 << 16
                archive.writestr(info,payload,compresslevel=9)
        temporary.replace(output)

def main():
