    require(live.qualify_archive() == state['source_qualification'], 'Source archive/freeze drift')
    require(command(state['operation']['profile']) == state['operation']['command'], 'Launch argv drift')
    item = state['complete_option_inventory']; require(file_hash(Path(item['path'])) == item['sha256'], 'Complete Iris inventory drift')
    require(profile_snapshot(state['operation']['profile']) == state['prepared_profile'], 'Prepared profile/parent/settings/save drift')
    require(not (Path(state['operation']['profile']) / 'benchmark.json').exists(), 'Profile has been used; preserve it and prepare a new family')
    require(matrix.canonical_options_hash(state['expected_effective_options']) == analyzer.OPTIONS_HASH,
        'Full candidate option map drift')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(status='verified-source-stage', launch_authorized=False, launch_status=state['launch_status'])


def finalize(marker, receipt_path, receipt_sha256):
    marker = Path(marker).resolve()
    require(marker.parent.parent == ROOT / 'run-workloads' and marker.parent.name in OWNED_FAMILIES
        and marker.name == 'live-pixel-control-preparation.json', 'Only owned staged receipt allowed')
    state = json.loads(marker.read_text()); verify_source(state); matrix.require_exclusive_runtime()
    if state['status'] == FINAL:
        require(state['independent_artifact_receipt']['path'] == str(Path(receipt_path).resolve())
            and state['independent_artifact_receipt']['sha256'] == receipt_sha256, 'Finalized receipt replacement forbidden')
        verify(state); return state
    receipt, directories = coverage.qualify_receipt(receipt_path, receipt_sha256)
    runtime_sources = current_runtime_sources(); compiled = matrix.development_fingerprints()
    # No profile/save/control files are rewritten during finalization.
    state.update(status=FINAL, independent_artifact_receipt=receipt, auxiliary_directory_identities=directories,
        runtime_sources_sha256=runtime_sources, development_runtime_inputs=compiled,
        launch_status='READY FOR ROOT REVIEW: separate raster evidence remains pending; settled cost diagnostic only')
    require(coverage.qualify_receipt(receipt_path, receipt_sha256) == (receipt, directories), 'Artifact drift during finalization')
    require(current_runtime_sources() == runtime_sources and matrix.development_fingerprints() == compiled,
        'Runtime sources/classes changed during finalization')
    verify_source(state); write_json(marker, state)
    return state


def verify(state):
    verify_source(state)
    require(state['status'] == FINAL, 'Current independent runtime receipt required before launch')
    require(current_runtime_sources() == state['runtime_sources_sha256'], 'Current runtime sources drift')
    require(matrix.development_fingerprints() == state['development_runtime_inputs'], 'Compiled runtime drift')
    entry = state['independent_artifact_receipt']; receipt, directories = coverage.qualify_receipt(entry['path'], entry['sha256'])
    require(receipt == entry and directories == state['auxiliary_directory_identities'], 'Current artifact receipt/directory drift')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(status='verified-source-and-current-runtime-ready', launch_authorized=False,
        launch_status=state['launch_status'], owned_live_processes=[])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true'); parser.add_argument('--stage', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--finalize', type=Path); parser.add_argument('--verify', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--artifact-receipt', type=Path); parser.add_argument('--artifact-receipt-sha256')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=OUTPUT); parser.add_argument('--build', type=Path, default=BUILD)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        require(sum(bool(x) for x in (args.dry_run, args.stage, args.finalize, args.verify)) == 1, 'Select exactly one dry-run/stage/finalize/verify operation')
        if args.verify: result = verify(json.loads(args.verify.read_text()))
        elif args.finalize:
            require(args.artifact_receipt is not None and args.artifact_receipt_sha256 is not None, 'Explicit root final artifact receipt path/hash required')
            result = finalize(args.finalize, args.artifact_receipt, args.artifact_receipt_sha256)
        else: result = plan(args.output, args.build) if args.dry_run else stage(args.output, args.build)
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as failure:
        parser.exit(1, 'Cannot prepare live-pixel settled screen: ' + str(failure) + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

def positive(value):
    return isinstance(value,(float,int)) and not isinstance(value,bool) and math.isfinite(value) and value > 0


def percentile(values, fraction):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    return ordered[max(0, math.ceil(len(ordered)*fraction)-1)]


def sample_rows(report, key, scope, fields):
    rows = report.get(key)
    require(isinstance(rows,list) and rows, 'Missing '+key)
    if key == 'gpu_samples': require(all(r.get('scope') == scope for r in rows), 'GPU scope differs')
    rows = [r for r in rows if r.get('scope') == scope]
    require(rows, 'Missing '+scope+' stream')
    ids = [r.get('frameId') for r in rows]; epochs = [r.get('epoch') for r in rows]
    require(all(isinstance(v,int) and not isinstance(v,bool) and v>=0 for v in ids+epochs), 'Invalid frame/epoch')
    require(ids == sorted(set(ids)) and len(set(epochs)) == 1, 'Duplicate/unordered IDs or mixed epochs')
    require(all(positive(r.get(f)) for r in rows for f in fields), 'Nonpositive/nonfinite sample or absent thread clock')
    return rows


def analyze_rows(report, shared_host=False, warmup_seconds=None, capture_seconds=None):
    """Evidence-preserving arithmetic only; caller still must validate all guards."""
    warmup, capture_seconds = durations(shared_host, warmup_seconds, capture_seconds)
    require(positive(report.get('elapsed_seconds')) and report['elapsed_seconds'] >= capture_seconds,
            'Short/nonfinite capture duration')
    require(report.get('warmup_seconds') == warmup, 'Warmup differs')
    frames = report.get('render_frames')
    require(isinstance(frames,int) and not isinstance(frames,bool) and frames > 0, 'Invalid render_frames')
    gpu = [] if shared_host else sample_rows(report,'gpu_samples','game-render',['milliseconds'])
    if shared_host:
        require(report.get('gpu_samples') == [], 'Query-free capture has GPU samples')
    cpu = sample_rows(report,'cpu_samples','run-tick',['wallMilliseconds','threadMilliseconds'])
    require(shared_host or len(gpu)>=360, 'Insufficient total GPU samples')
    require(all(b['frameId']-a['frameId']==5 for a,b in zip(gpu,gpu[1:])), 'GPU N5 gaps')
    require(all(b['frameId']-a['frameId']==1 for a,b in zip(cpu,cpu[1:])), 'CPU frame gap')
    require(not gpu or gpu[0]['epoch']==cpu[0]['epoch'], 'CPU/GPU epoch differs')
    capture = report['window_state']['capture']
    first, last = capture['start']['frame_id'], capture['end']['frame_id']
    require(last-first == frames and first<=cpu[0]['frameId']<=first+2
            and last-2<=cpu[-1]['frameId']<=last and 0<=frames-len(cpu)<=2, 'CPU boundary coverage differs')
    clock = {}; wall = thread = 0.0
    for row in cpu:
        require(row['threadMilliseconds'] <= row['wallMilliseconds']+1.0, 'Thread time exceeds wall implausibly')
        midpoint = (wall+row['wallMilliseconds']/2)/1000
        wall += row['wallMilliseconds']; thread += row['threadMilliseconds']
        clock[row['frameId']] = dict(seconds=midpoint, wall=wall, thread=thread)
    coverage = wall/1000/report['elapsed_seconds']
    require(.98 <= coverage <= 1.005, 'Cumulative CPU wall-clock coverage insufficient/excessive')
    require(all(first<=r['frameId']<=last and r['frameId'] in clock for r in gpu), 'GPU frame missing CPU time join')
    results = {}
    for width in ((20,) if shared_host else (10,20)):
        bins = []
        for begin in range(0,capture_seconds,width):
            select = lambda r: begin <= clock[r['frameId']]['seconds'] < begin+width
            cs = [r for r in cpu if select(r)]; gs = [r for r in gpu if select(r)]
            require(cs and (shared_host or len(gs) >= width*3), 'Insufficient bin coverage')
            ws=[r['wallMilliseconds'] for r in cs]; ts=[r['threadMilliseconds'] for r in cs]; ms=[r['milliseconds'] for r in gs]
            bins.append(dict(start_seconds=begin,end_seconds=begin+width,frame_count=len(cs),gpu_count=len(gs),
                first_frame_id=cs[0]['frameId'],last_frame_id=cs[-1]['frameId'],
                gpu_median_ms=statistics.median(ms) if ms else None,gpu_mean_ms=statistics.mean(ms) if ms else None,gpu_p95_ms=percentile(ms,.95) if ms else None,
                cpu_wall_mean_ms=statistics.mean(ws),cpu_thread_mean_ms=statistics.mean(ts),
                cpu_wall_sum_ms=sum(ws),cpu_thread_sum_ms=sum(ts),
                cpu_wall_minus_thread_mean_ms=statistics.mean(w-t for w,t in zip(ws,ts)),
                cpu_wall_minus_thread_sum_ms=sum(w-t for w,t in zip(ws,ts)),
                cumulative_cpu_wall_ms=clock[cs[-1]['frameId']]['wall'],
                cumulative_cpu_thread_ms=clock[cs[-1]['frameId']]['thread'],
                reconstructed_frame_ms=statistics.mean(ws),reconstructed_fps=1000/statistics.mean(ws)))
        metrics = {}
        for key in (('reconstructed_frame_ms',) if shared_host else ('gpu_median_ms','reconstructed_frame_ms')):
            values=[b[key] for b in bins]
            metrics[key]=dict(range_fraction=(max(values)-min(values))/min(values),
                final_first_drift_fraction=abs(values[-1]/values[0]-1))
        results[str(width)] = dict(bins=bins,metrics=metrics,
            observed_unstable=any(v>(.03 if shared_host else .10)+1e-12 for m in metrics.values() for v in m.values()))
    return EVIDENCE | dict(runtime='arithmetic-only-not-runtime-qualified',
        declared_protocol=dict(warmup_seconds=warmup,capture_seconds=capture_seconds,shared_host=shared_host,maximum_drift_fraction=.03 if shared_host else .10),
        verdict='observed-unstable' if any(r['observed_unstable'] for r in results.values()) else 'no-observed-instability-in-this-session',
        gpu_count=len(gpu),gpu_median_ms=statistics.median(r['milliseconds'] for r in gpu) if gpu else None,
        elapsed_seconds=report['elapsed_seconds'],render_frames=frames,
        total_frame_mean_ms=report['elapsed_seconds']*1000/frames,
        cumulative_cpu_wall_ms=wall,cumulative_cpu_thread_ms=thread,
        cumulative_cpu_wall_minus_thread_ms=wall-thread,residual_interpretation="Wall minus thread includes waits, scheduling and other causes; descriptive only, never contention-corrected timing",
        wall_clock_coverage=coverage,
        cpu_boundary_frame_omissions=frames-len(cpu),resolutions=results,
        time_source='Reconstructed cumulative coarse run-tick wall, joined by frame ID; no absolute row timestamps. Includes timing overhead; boundary omissions/untimed gaps retained as coverage.',
        decision_scope='Arithmetic only. Root runtime guards must pass; no promotion/causal or inter-JVM stability inference.')


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path)

def screen(frame_ms, gpu_ms):
    """Arithmetic only; strict independent runtime and quality guards precede this decision."""
    require(len(frame_ms) == len(gpu_ms) == 5 and all(type(v) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(v) and v > 0
        for v in (*frame_ms,*gpu_ms)), 'Need five positive finite frame/GPU metrics')
    drift = {name:dict(frame=abs(frame_ms[end]/frame_ms[start]-1), gpu=abs(gpu_ms[end]/gpu_ms[start]-1))
        for name,start,end in (('original',0,4), ('stock',1,3))}
    frame_gain = [frame_ms[i]/frame_ms[2]-1 for i in (0,4)]
    frame_reduction = [1-frame_ms[2]/frame_ms[i] for i in (0,4)]
    gpu_reduction = [1-gpu_ms[2]/gpu_ms[i] for i in (0,4)]
    overhead = dict(frame=[frame_ms[2]/frame_ms[i]-1 for i in (1,3)], gpu=[gpu_ms[2]/gpu_ms[i]-1 for i in (1,3)])
    verdict = ('inconclusive-control-drift' if max(x for d in drift.values() for x in d.values()) > .10 + 1e-12 else
        'stop-no-useful-original-signal' if min(frame_reduction) <= .05 + 1e-12 or min(gpu_reduction) <= 0 else
        'promising-original-denominator-diagnostic-only')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(verdict=verdict, control_drift=drift, fps_gain_vs_each_original=frame_gain,
        frame_reduction_vs_each_original=frame_reduction, gpu_reduction_vs_each_original=gpu_reduction,
        adapter_overhead_vs_each_stock=overhead,
        limitation='No repeated/causal/quality-equivalent gain. Guarded serial arithmetic only; .75 reduces raster detail.')

        evidence_paths='Per-arm control/workload-measurement.json, logs/screenshots and root initial/terminal process receipts; retain all raw failures')


def qualify_boundary_configuration(snapshot, prepared, archive_name):
    """Complete capture-time semantics with narrow source-backed startup roles; raw retained."""
    require(snapshot.get('complete') is True and snapshot.get('errors') == [] and isinstance(snapshot.get('files'),dict),
        'Incomplete capture-boundary configuration')
    files=snapshot['files']; settings={}; identities={}; sidecars={}; backups={}
    expected=set(prepared['settings']) | set(prepared['nonshader_identities'])
    for name,item in files.items():
        require(isinstance(name,str) and not Path(name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(name).parts,
            'Unsafe capture configuration path')
        require(isinstance(item,dict) and type(item.get('bytes')) is int and item['bytes'] >= 0
            and isinstance(item.get('sha256'),str), 'Malformed configuration record')
        text=item.get('utf8')
        if text is not None:
            require(isinstance(text,str) and len(text.encode()) == item['bytes']
                and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() == item['sha256'], 'Configuration text/hash mismatch')
        if name.startswith('shaderpacks/') and name.endswith('.zip.txt'):
            require(name == 'shaderpacks/' + archive_name + '.txt' and text is not None, 'Unqualified sidecar inventory')
            sidecars[name]=canonical.semantic_properties(text); continue
        if name == 'config/shaderlod-client-1.toml.bak' and name not in expected:
            require(text is not None and tomllib.loads(text) == prepared['settings']['config/shaderlod-client.toml']['value'],
                'First main backup differs from complete prepared main')
            backups[name]=item; continue
        require(name in expected, 'Unqualified startup configuration inventory: ' + name)
        if name == 'config/sodium-fingerprint.json':
            require(text is not None, 'Sodium UTF8 missing'); value=json.loads(text)
            require(set(value)=={'v','s','u','p','t'} and type(value['v']) is int and value['v']==1
                and type(value['t']) is int and all(isinstance(value[k],str) and len(value[k])==128
                and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in value[k]) for k in ('s','u','p')), 'Unknown Sodium cache schema')
            identities[name]=dict(raw=value,sha256=item['sha256']); continue
        model=prepared['settings'][name]; fmt=model['format']
        if fmt == 'toml': require(text is not None,'TOML UTF8 missing'); value=tomllib.loads(text)
        elif fmt == 'json': require(text is not None,'JSON UTF8 missing'); value=json.loads(text)
        elif fmt in ('simple literal properties','minecraft colon properties'):
            require(text is not None,'Properties UTF8 missing'); value=canonical.semantic_properties(text, ':' if fmt=='minecraft colon properties' else '=')
        else:
            require(item['sha256']==model['sha256'], 'Unknown configuration bytes changed')
            settings[name]=dict(format=fmt,sha256=item['sha256']); continue
        settings[name]=dict(format=fmt,value=value)
    require(set(files)-set(sidecars)-set(backups) == expected, 'Captured configuration inventory missing')
    require(settings == prepared['settings'], 'Unqualified startup configuration semantic change')
    values=next(iter(sidecars.values()),{})
    normalized=canonical.normalize_requested_options(prepared['sidecar']['defaults'],values)
    require(matrix.canonical_options_hash(normalized) == prepared['sidecar']['semantic_sha256'], 'Capture full sidecar semantics changed')
    return dict(settings=settings, nonshader_identities=identities, qualified_first_backup=backups,
        sidecar_semantic_sha256=matrix.canonical_options_hash(normalized), actual_configuration_files=snapshot)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true'); parser.add_argument('--prepare',action='store_true'); parser.add_argument('--verify',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=OUTPUT); parser.add_argument('--build',type=Path,default=BUILD)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        require(sum(bool(x) for x in (args.dry_run,args.prepare,args.verify))==1, 'Select exactly one dry-run/prepare/verify')
        result=verify(json.loads(args.verify.read_text())) if args.verify else plan(args.output,args.build) if args.dry_run else prepare(args.output,args.build)
        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,zipfile.BadZipFile) as failure:
        parser.exit(1,'Cannot prepare original Photon pixel baseline: '+str(failure)+'\n')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

    require(live.qualify_archive() == state['source_qualification'], 'Archive/source freeze drift')
    require(source_files() == state['source_files_sha256'], 'Maintained source drift')
    require(matrix.development_fingerprints() == state['development_runtime_inputs'], 'Compiled runtime drift')
    entry = state['independent_artifact_receipt']; receipt, directories = qualify_receipt(entry['path'], entry['sha256'])
    require(receipt == entry and directories == state['auxiliary_directory_identities'], 'Independent receipt/directory drift')
    inventory = state['complete_option_inventory']; require(file_hash(Path(inventory['path'])) == inventory['sha256'], 'Option inventory drift')
    for row in state['launch_plan']:
        profile = Path(row['profile'])
        require(matrix.profile_inputs(profile) == row['inputs'], 'Prepared recipe drift')
        require(all(file_hash(Path(p)) == pin for p, pin in row['input_files_sha256'].items()), 'Prepared file drift')
        require(canonical.writable_settings(profile) == row['prepared_writable_settings'], 'Prepared complete settings drift')
        require(world_fingerprint(profile / 'saves' / WORLD) == state['source_world_sha256'], 'Copied source save drift')
        require(command(profile) == row['command'], 'Prepared command drift')
    require(validate_pair(state['launch_plan']) == state['prepared_pair'], 'Prepared pair comparison drift')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(status='verified-source-ready', launch_authorized=False, owned_live_processes=[])


def main():

    parser.add_argument('--artifact-receipt', type=Path); parser.add_argument('--artifact-receipt-sha256')

    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as failure:
        parser.exit(1, 'Cannot prepare pixel-coverage controls: ' + str(failure) + '\n')

def qualify_rain(report, request):
    require(type(request.get('fixed_wetness')) in (int,float) and request['fixed_wetness']==1,'Rain wetness target must be one')
    cost.matrix.validate_temporal_inputs(report,request)
    for boundary in ('input_state_start','input_state_end'):
        state=report.get(boundary,{})
        require(type(state.get('rain')) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(state['rain']) and abs(state['rain']-1)<1e-6,'Settled rain missing')
        require(type(state.get('thunder')) in (int,float) and abs(state['thunder'])<1e-6,'Rain-only thunder differs')
    for boundary in ('shader_temporal_inputs_start','shader_temporal_inputs_end'):
        state=report.get(boundary,{})
        require(type(state.get('rain_strength_source')) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(state['rain_strength_source'])
            and abs(state['rain_strength_source']-1)<1e-6,'Observed rainStrength CPU source differs')
    return dict(rain_source=1,fixed_applied_wetness=1,shader_uniform_readback=False,fog_coefficients_readback=False)


def screen(frames, gpu):
    require(len(frames)==len(gpu)==3 and all(type(v) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in (*frames,*gpu)),
        'Three positive finite frame/GPU values required')
    drift=dict(frame=abs(frames[2]/frames[0]-1),gpu=abs(gpu[2]/gpu[0]-1))
    gains=[frames[i]/frames[1]-1 for i in (0,2)]; reductions=[1-gpu[1]/gpu[i] for i in (0,2)]
    verdict=('inconclusive-control-drift' if max(drift.values())>.10+1e-12 else
        'stop-no-useful-ceiling' if min(gains)<=.05+1e-12 or min(reductions)<=0 else 'useful-maximum-removal-calibration-only')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(verdict=verdict,control_drift=drift,fps_gain_vs_each_vl=gains,gpu_reduction_vs_each_vl=reductions,
        optical_tail_implementation_accepted=False)

        'Actual60warm20capture/full-game-render N5 >=60 usable positive epoch rows, FOUR coarse CPU scopes/wall coverage, all probes/pass/attribution/history/trace/culling flagsOFF. No reader gate weakening or fake rows.',
        'Matrices/fogcoefficients/actual eligible cells unavailable. Retain final PNG/hash as quality-changing maximum-removal result, never quality acceptance.'],
        cross_arm=[

def audit_equivalence(path, receipt):
    """Reuse only the pre-existing exact audited API Base pair; verify real payloads."""
    result = load_equivalences(path)
    entry = result['entry']; payloads = []
    for variant in entry['variants']:
        parent = ROOT / 'dev/runtime' / variant['parent_filename']
        require(file_hash(parent) == variant['parent_sha256'], 'Equivalence parent pin differs')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(parent) as archive:
            data = archive.read(variant['embedded_path'])
        require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == variant['sha256'], 'Equivalence member pin differs')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as nested:
            names = [n for n in nested.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
            require(len(names) == len(set(names)), 'Duplicate equivalence payload names')
            payloads.append({n: nested.read(n) for n in names})
    require(payloads[0].keys() == payloads[1].keys(), 'Equivalence payload inventory differs')
    changed = [n for n in payloads[0] if payloads[0][n] != payloads[1][n]]
    require(changed == ['META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml'], 'Equivalence nonmetadata payload differs')
    for kind, select in (
        ('classes', lambda n: n.endswith('.class')),
        ('resources_except_changed_metadata', lambda n: not n.endswith('.class') and n not in changed),
        ('all_files_except_changed_metadata', lambda n: n not in changed)):
        for payload in payloads:
            selected = sorted(n for n in payload if select(n))
            encoded = ''.join(n + '\0' + hashlib.sha256(payload[n]).hexdigest() + '\n' for n in selected)
            actual = dict(file_count=len(selected), sha256=hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest())
            require(actual == entry['proof'][kind], 'Equivalence extracted payload fingerprint differs')
    expected = receipt['expected_loaded_mods']
    require(all(expected.get(k) == v for k,v in entry['required_loaded_mods'].items()), 'Equivalence runtime differs')
    return result | {'actual_extracted_payloads_verified': True,
        'policy': 'Exact independently audited metadata-only pair qualified; preserve actual parent/member/hash in every arm. Unknown variants or other root differences are inconclusive.'}

def qualify_configuration_snapshot(snapshot, prepared):
    """Decode the actual bounded boundary snapshot; never substitute postrun files."""
    require(snapshot.get('complete') is True and snapshot.get('errors')==[] and isinstance(snapshot.get('files'),dict),
            'Incomplete capture-boundary configuration files')
    files=snapshot['files'];settings={};identities={};sidecars={}
    expected=set(prepared['settings'])|set(prepared['nonshader_identities'])
    for name,item in files.items():
        require(isinstance(name,str) and not Path(name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(name).parts,
                'Unsafe capture configuration path')
        require(isinstance(item,dict) and isinstance(item.get('bytes'),int) and not isinstance(item['bytes'],bool)
                and item['bytes']>=0 and isinstance(item.get('sha256'),str),'Malformed configuration record')
        text=item.get('utf8')
        if text is not None:
            require(isinstance(text,str) and len(text.encode())==item['bytes']
                    and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],'Configuration text/hash mismatch')
        if name.startswith('shaderpacks/') and name.endswith('.zip.txt'):
            require(text is not None,'Sidecar UTF8 missing')
            sidecars[name]=quality.semantic_properties(text)
            continue
        require(name in expected,'Unqualified startup configuration inventory: '+name)
        if name=='config/sodium-fingerprint.json':
            require(text is not None,'Sodium fingerprint UTF8 missing')
            value=json.loads(text)
            require(set(value)=={'v','s','u','p','t'} and isinstance(value['v'],int)
                    and not isinstance(value['v'],bool) and value['v']==1 and isinstance(value['t'],int)
                    and not isinstance(value['t'],bool) and all(isinstance(value[k],str) and len(value[k])==128
                    and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in value[k]) for k in ('s','u','p')),
                    'Unknown Sodium fingerprint identity schema')
            identities[name]=dict(raw=value,sha256=item['sha256'])
        else:
            model=prepared['settings'][name];format=model['format']
            if format=='toml':
                require(text is not None,'TOML UTF8 missing');value=tomllib.loads(text)
            elif format=='json':
                require(text is not None,'JSON UTF8 missing');value=json.loads(text)
            elif format in ('simple literal properties','minecraft colon properties'):
                require(text is not None,'Properties UTF8 missing')
                value=quality.semantic_properties(text,':' if format=='minecraft colon properties' else '=')
            else:
                require(item['sha256']==model['sha256'],'Unknown configuration bytes changed')
                settings[name]=dict(format=format,sha256=item['sha256']);continue
            settings[name]=dict(format=format,value=value)
    require(set(files)-set(sidecars)==expected,'Capture configuration inventory missing')
    require(settings==prepared['settings'],'Unqualified startup configuration semantic change')
    # Only this original ZIP exists in a prepared profile. Missing all-default
    # sidecars are legal; arbitrary extra sidecars are never normalized away.
    require(len(sidecars)<=1 and all(Path(n).name=='photon_v1.3b.zip.txt' for n in sidecars),
            'Unqualified sidecar inventory')
    values=next(iter(sidecars.values()),{})
    normalized=quality.normalize_requested_options(prepared['sidecar']['defaults'],values)
    require(canonical_options_hash(normalized)==prepared['sidecar']['semantic_sha256'],
            'Capture full sidecar semantics changed')
    return dict(settings=settings,nonshader_identities=identities,sidecar_semantic_sha256=canonical_options_hash(normalized),
        actual_configuration_files=snapshot,
        qualification='Complete captured settings; exact original defaults only; explicit Sodium salted UUID/path cache role, all raw records retained')

def freeze_sources(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    names = ('build.gradle', 'settings.gradle', 'gradlew', 'gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar',
             'gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'dev/runtime.lock.json', 'dev/performance-mods.lock.json',
             'dev/runtime-artifact-equivalences.json', 'scripts/prepare_photon_taau_cost_bracket.py',
             'scripts/prepare_photon_taau_screen.py', 'scripts/run_proof_matrix.py', 'scripts/setup_comparison.py',
             'scripts/qualify_volume_fast_artifacts.py', 'scripts/analyze_stack_matrix.py',
             'scripts/prepare_isolations.py', 'scripts/prepare_reduced_effects_profiles.py',
             'scripts/prepare_photon_ao_reuse_profiles.py', 'tests/test_photon_taau_cost_bracket.py')
    paths = [root / n for n in names]
    # Freeze actual imported repository helpers as well as the explicit entry
    # points; workers' independent scripts remain outside this read-only graph.
    for module in tuple(sys.modules.values()):
        name=getattr(module,'__file__',None)
        if name:
            path=Path(name).resolve()
            if path.suffix=='.py' and path.is_relative_to(root/'scripts'):
                paths.append(path)
    for tree in ('src/main', 'src/devClient'):
        paths += [p for p in (root / tree).rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
    require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in paths), 'Frozen source has symlinks')
    return {str(p): file_hash(p) for p in sorted(set(paths))}

def screen(frame_ms, gpu_ms):
    """Decision arithmetic only; caller must independently pass every evidence gate."""
    require(len(frame_ms) == len(gpu_ms) == 3 and all(isinstance(v,(float,int)) and not isinstance(v,bool)
            and math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in (*frame_ms,*gpu_ms)), 'Need three positive finite frame/GPU metrics')
    drift = dict(frame=abs(frame_ms[2]/frame_ms[0]-1), gpu=abs(gpu_ms[2]/gpu_ms[0]-1))
    frames = [1-frame_ms[1]/frame_ms[i] for i in (0,2)]
    gpus = [1-gpu_ms[1]/gpu_ms[i] for i in (0,2)]
    verdict = ('inconclusive-original-drift' if max(drift.values()) > .10 + 1e-12 else
               'stop-no-useful-signal' if min(frames) <= .05 + 1e-12 or min(gpus) <= 0 else
               'promising-diagnostic-only')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(verdict=verdict, original_drift=drift, frame_reductions=frames,
        gpu_reductions=gpus, acceptance='Arithmetic only; runtime evidence gates must pass independently')

        actual={str(p):file_hash(p) for p in sorted(profile.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and not p.is_relative_to(profile/'saves')}
        require(actual==row['profile_prelaunch_files_sha256'],'Prelaunch profile byte/inventory drift')
        require(profile_inputs(profile)==row['inputs'],'Prepared profile contract drift')
        require(writable_inventory(profile)==row['prepared_writable_inventory'],'Prepared writable semantics drift')
    return EVIDENCE|dict(status='source-prelaunch-verified',launch_status=state['launch_status'],owned_live_processes=[])


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=OUTPUT)
    parser.add_argument('--artifact-receipt',type=Path,default=RECEIPT)
    parser.add_argument('--artifact-sha256',default=RECEIPT_SHA256)
    parser.add_argument('--unity-graph',action='store_true',help='Fresh query-free native/TAAU1.00/native graph diagnostic, current R14 and main global OFF')
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--verify',type=Path)

        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:

def option_maps(effective):
    require(canonical_options_hash(effective) == SOURCE_OPTIONS_SHA256, 'Canonical effective map differs')
    require(effective.get('TAA') == 'true' and effective.get('TAAU') == 'false'
            and effective.get('TAAU_RENDER_SCALE') == '0.75', 'Canonical temporal options differ')
    require(not any(k.startswith(('SHADERLOD_', 'PHOTON_')) for k in effective), 'Private option contamination')
    return {'native': dict(effective), 'taau90': effective | {'TAAU': 'true', 'TAAU_RENDER_SCALE': '0.90'},
            'taau85': effective | {'TAAU': 'true', 'TAAU_RENDER_SCALE': '0.85'}}


def plan(output, source=SOURCE, root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root).resolve(); raw = Path(output)
    require(not raw.is_symlink() and not Path(source).is_symlink(), 'Symlink source/output unsupported')
    output, source = raw.resolve(), Path(source).resolve()
    require(any(output.is_relative_to(root / n) and output != root / n for n in ('build', 'run-workloads')), 'Output must be ignored')
    require(not output.exists(), 'Preserving existing output; use a fresh directory')
    require(output != source and output not in source.parents and source not in output.parents
            and source.parent not in output.parents, 'Output must be separate from source')
    return EVIDENCE | dict(schema=1, output=str(output), source=str(source), original_sha256=ORIGINAL_SHA256,
        arms=list(ARMS), kinds=list(KINDS), deferred_arm='taau85 only after root accepts 0.90 still/motion quality',
        expected_framebuffer=[2976, 1672], expected_window=[1488, 836], requested_chunks=24,
        main_mod_present=False, dh_present=False, performance_stack='minimal', client_gpu_owner='root',
        validation='Path plan only; save/source qualification pending')


def semantic_properties(text, separator='='):
    """Narrow config syntax; do not silently discard unknown/duplicate/continued lines."""
    result = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith(('#', '!')): continue
        require(separator in line and not line.rstrip().endswith('\\'), 'Unsupported property syntax')
        key, value = line.split(separator, 1); key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
        require(key and key not in result, 'Duplicate/empty property key')
        # Preserve escaped literal bytes, rather than claiming Java escape equivalence.
        result[key] = value
    return result


def writable_settings(profile):
    """Complete semantic config inventory; explicit Sodium cache identity is retained separately."""
    profile = Path(profile)
    settings, identities = {}, {}
    paths = [profile / 'options.txt'] + sorted(p for p in (profile / 'config').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in paths), 'Symlink writable configuration')
    for path in paths:
        name = path.relative_to(profile).as_posix(); text = path.read_text()
        if name == 'config/sodium-fingerprint.json':
            value = json.loads(text)
            require(set(value) == {'v', 's', 'u', 'p', 't'} and value['v'] == 1
                    and isinstance(value['t'], int) and not isinstance(value['t'], bool)
                    and all(isinstance(value[k], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{128}', value[k]) for k in ('s', 'u', 'p')),
                    'Unknown Sodium fingerprint identity schema')
            identities[name] = dict(role='Sodium hardware/user/process cache identity, not a shader setting',
                                   raw=value, sha256=file_hash(path))
        elif path.suffix == '.toml': settings[name] = dict(format='toml', value=tomllib.loads(text))
        elif path.suffix == '.json': settings[name] = dict(format='json', value=json.loads(text))
        elif name == 'options.txt': settings[name] = dict(format='minecraft colon properties', value=semantic_properties(text, ':'))
        elif path.suffix == '.properties': settings[name] = dict(format='simple literal properties', value=semantic_properties(text))
        else: settings[name] = dict(format='unrecognized exact bytes', sha256=file_hash(path))
    return dict(settings=settings, settings_sha256=canonical_options_hash(settings), nonshader_identities=identities,
        policy='Pin prepared receipt; before capture compare complete startup-normalized settings across arms and end boundary. '
               'No generic ignored files/keys. Preserve raw cache identity receipts separately; any other semantic change rejects.')


def qualify_source(source=SOURCE, root=ROOT, audit=AUDIT):
    source, root = Path(source).resolve(), Path(root).resolve()
    require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in source.rglob('*')), 'Source contains symlinks')
    report_path = source / 'workload-measurement.json'
    require(file_hash(report_path) == SOURCE_REPORT_SHA256, 'Canonical source report pin differs')
    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
    require(report.get('status') == 'complete' and report.get('actual_shader_sha256') == ORIGINAL_SHA256
            and report.get('dhPresent') is False and report.get('modPresent') is False, 'Source status/archive/mod presence differs')
    effective = report['effective_shader_options']; maps = option_maps(effective)
    require(report.get('effective_shader_options_sha256') == SOURCE_OPTIONS_SHA256, 'Source map receipt differs')
    for boundary in ('input_state_start', 'input_state_end'):
        state = report[boundary]
        require([state.get('framebuffer_width'), state.get('framebuffer_height')] == [2976, 1672]
                and state.get('requested_chunks') == state.get('effective_chunks') == 24
                and state.get('shaders_in_use') is True and state.get('fallback') is False, 'Source viewport/radius/pipeline differs')
    runtime_path = root / 'dev/runtime.lock.json'; runtime = json.loads(runtime_path.read_text())
    iris = read_option_properties((source / 'config/iris.properties').read_text()); selected = iris['shaderPack']
    require(Path(selected).name == selected and iris.get('enableShaders') == 'true', 'Source Iris selection invalid')
    archive_path = source / 'shaderpacks' / selected
    original = archive_contents(archive_path, ORIGINAL_SHA256, runtime['artifacts']['photon'])
    require(file_hash(archive_path, 'sha512') == runtime['artifacts']['photon']['hashes']['sha512'], 'Original SHA512 differs')
    canonical = root / 'dev/upstream/photon_v1.3b.zip'
    require(file_hash(canonical) == ORIGINAL_SHA256, 'Canonical upstream archive differs')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        defaults = archive_defaults(archive)
        members = {n: __import__('hashlib').sha256(archive.read(n)).hexdigest() for n in archive.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')}
    require(not any(n.startswith('shaderlod-') for n in members), 'Archive must be unmodified original')
    sidecar = archive_path.with_name(selected + '.txt'); requested = read_option_properties(sidecar.read_text()) if sidecar.exists() else {}
    native, option_evidence = filter_effective_options(effective, requested, original, original)
    requests = {'native': native, 'taau90': native | {'TAAU': 'true', 'TAAU_RENDER_SCALE': '0.90'}}
    for arm, values in requests.items(): normalize_requested_options(defaults, values)
    audit = Path(audit); audit_data = json.loads(audit.read_text())
    require(audit_data['source_report_sha256'] == SOURCE_REPORT_SHA256
            and audit_data['source_effective_options_sha256'] == SOURCE_OPTIONS_SHA256, 'Parser audit source pin differs')
    for arm, scale in (('taau90', '0.90'), ('taau85', '0.85')):
        audited = audit_data['candidate_effective_options'][scale]
        require(audited['options'] == maps[arm] and audited['sha256'] == canonical_options_hash(maps[arm]), 'Parser audit map prediction differs')
    manifest_path, control_path = source.parent / 'workload-manifest.json', source.parent / 'control.json'
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    require(manifest.get('configuration_only') is False and manifest.get('source_world_sha256'), 'Source world provenance absent')
    control, removed = control_for_scene(json.loads(control_path.read_text()), 'coastalwater')
    require(not any((source / 'mods').glob('*.jar')), 'Source must have no profile mods or DH')
    settings = writable_settings(source)
    require(settings['settings']['options.txt']['value']['renderDistance'] == '24', 'Source detailed radius differs')
    files = [report_path, manifest_path, control_path, archive_path, canonical, runtime_path, audit]
    files += [p for p in (source / 'config').rglob('*') if p.is_file()] + [source / 'options.txt']
    if sidecar.exists(): files.append(sidecar)
    for name in ('iris', 'sodium'):
        pin = runtime['artifacts'][name]; path = root / 'dev/runtime' / pin['filename']
        require(file_hash(path, 'sha512') == pin['hashes']['sha512'], 'Pinned runtime jar differs: ' + name); files.append(path)
    return dict(source=source, world=source / 'saves' / WORLD, archive=archive_path, control=control,
        qualification=dict(qualified=True, archive_sha256=ORIGINAL_SHA256,
            archive_sha512=file_hash(archive_path, 'sha512'), complete_archive_member_sha256=members,
            license_sha256=original['license_sha256'], attribution='Photon v1.3b by Benjamin Stott (SixthSurge); original LICENSE retained',
            modified_upstream_members=[], upstream_option_calibration=True, runtime_lock=runtime,
            runtime_lock_sha256=file_hash(runtime_path), effective_option_maps=maps,
            effective_option_hashes={k: canonical_options_hash(v) for k, v in maps.items()},
            dynamic_predicted_option_counts={k: len(v) for k, v in maps.items()},
            option_evidence=option_evidence, removed_control_overrides=removed, source_provenance=manifest,
            source_files_sha256={str(p): file_hash(p) for p in sorted(set(files))}),
        requested_options=requests, source_writable_settings=settings)


def command(profile, kind, camera_request=None):
    require(kind in KINDS, 'Unknown quality kind')
    require(kind != 'motion' or camera_request is not None, 'Motion request missing')

            '-PinitialWarmup=30', '-PmeasurementSeconds=5', '-PcpuTiming=' + str(kind == 'still').lower(),
            '-PmeasureWorkload=' + str(kind == 'still').lower(), '-PmeasureOnly=' + str(kind == 'still').lower(),
            '-PcameraQualityOnly=' + str(kind == 'motion').lower(),
            '-PcameraQuality=' + (str(Path(camera_request).resolve()) if kind == 'motion' else '')]
    argv += ['-P' + name + '=false' for name in OFF]
    for task in BUILD_TASKS: argv += ['-x', task]

def motion_request():

def prepare(output, source=SOURCE, root=ROOT, audit=AUDIT):
    operation = plan(output, source, root); require_exclusive_runtime(); scene = qualify_source(source, root, audit)
    output = Path(operation['output']); root = Path(root).resolve()
    with unlocked_world(scene['world']):
        fingerprint = world_fingerprint(scene['world'])
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        state = EVIDENCE | dict(schema=1, status='preparing', operation=operation,
            source_qualification=scene['qualification'], source_world_sha256=fingerprint,
            created_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), launch_plan=[], stop_procedure=STOP,
            acceptance='Untimed driver/options/native extent, settled still then motion quality; no speed acceptance',
            runtime_guard_gaps=['Independent r2 artifact receipt and exact loaded inventory comparison pending root integration',
                'Full startup-normalized writable settings receipt must be captured before quality/timing acceptance',
                'Loaded complete Iris map must equal predicted per-arm map; source map is not runtime consumption',
                'Linked c3/c4 and active raster/native-history allocation not established by source parser',
                'Focus/window/pacing must be stably sampled and match baseline; motion harness lacks full window capture ledger',
                'Shader temporal clocks advance normally; time/wetness fixed but exact temporal phase alignment remains unproved',
                'Native GUI extent needs separate observation: quality camera hides GUI; Workload screenshot does not prove GUI sharpness'])
        marker = output / 'taau-screen-preparation.json'; write_json(marker, state)
        try:
            camera_path = output / 'camera-request-motion.json'; write_json(camera_path, motion_request())
            provenance = output / 'source-provenance'; provenance.mkdir()
            for src, name in ((scene['source'] / 'workload-measurement.json', 'workload-original.json'),
                              (scene['source'].parent / 'control.json', 'control-original.json'),
                              (scene['source'].parent / 'workload-manifest.json', 'manifest-original.json')):
                shutil.copy2(src, provenance / name)
            write_json(provenance / 'writable-settings-original.json', scene['source_writable_settings'])
            for kind in KINDS:
                base = output / kind; base.mkdir(); write_json(base / 'control.json', scene['control'])
                arms = {}
                for arm in ARMS:
                    profile = base / arm
                    storage_copytree(scene['source'], profile, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(*TRANSIENT))
                    world = profile / 'saves' / WORLD; world.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    storage_copytree(scene['world'], world, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('session.lock'))
                    require(world_fingerprint(world) == fingerprint, 'Copied world differs')
                    (profile / 'shaderpacks').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    archive = profile / 'shaderpacks' / scene['archive'].name; shutil.copy2(scene['archive'], archive)
                    values = scene['requested_options'][arm]
                    archive.with_name(archive.name + '.txt').write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k, v in sorted(values.items())))
                    iris_path = profile / 'config/iris.properties'; iris = read_option_properties(iris_path.read_text()); iris['shaderPack'] = archive.name
                    iris_path.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k, v in sorted(iris.items())))
                    (profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml').write_text(fresh_config('high'))
                    require(file_hash(archive) == ORIGINAL_SHA256 and not any((profile / 'mods').glob('*.jar')), 'Copied original/runtime scope differs')
                    writable = writable_settings(profile)
                    arms[arm] = dict(archive=archive.name, sha256=ORIGINAL_SHA256, requested_options=values,
                        expected_effective_options=scene['qualification']['effective_option_maps'][arm],
                        expected_effective_options_sha256=scene['qualification']['effective_option_hashes'][arm],
                        predicted_active_count=len(scene['qualification']['effective_option_maps'][arm]),
                        main_mod_present=False, global_enabled=False, dh_present=False, task='runClientLodOff',
                        prepared_writable_settings=writable, copied_world_sha256=fingerprint)
                    request = dict(run_id=f'taau-screen-r1-{kind}-{arm}', case='photon-native' if arm == 'native' else 'photon-taau90',
                        task='runClientLodOff', stack='minimal', include_dh=False, measurement_seconds=5,
                        gpu_queries=False, fixed_wetness=0, performanceEvidence=False, evidence_class='untimed-quality-screen')
                    if kind == 'still': write_json(profile / 'workload-request.json', request)
                    state['launch_plan'].append(dict(kind=kind, arm=arm, profile=str(profile), command=command(profile, kind, camera_path),
                        request=request if kind == 'still' else str(camera_path), status='not-launched', owner='root'))
                write_json(base / 'workload-manifest.json', dict(schema=1, scene='coastalwater', configuration_only=False,
                    preparation_status='complete', source_world=str(scene['world']), source_world_sha256=fingerprint,
                    original_sha256=ORIGINAL_SHA256, experiment_family=EXPERIMENT, experiment_arms=arms,
                    requested_chunks=24, expected_framebuffer=[2976, 1672], control=scene['control'], dh_installed=False,
                    main_mod_present=False, upstream_option_calibration=True, validation='Preparation only; no runtime/speed/quality acceptance'))
                for arm in ARMS:
                    profile = base / arm; inputs = profile_inputs(profile)
                    state.setdefault('profile_input_receipts', {})[str(profile)] = inputs
            require(world_fingerprint(scene['world']) == fingerprint, 'Source save changed during preparation')
            require(all(file_hash(Path(p)) == digest for p, digest in scene['qualification']['source_files_sha256'].items()), 'Source inputs changed during preparation')
            state['development_runtime_inputs'] = development_fingerprints()
            source_paths = [root / p for p in ('build.gradle', 'settings.gradle', 'gradlew', 'gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar',
                'gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'dev/runtime.lock.json', 'dev/performance-mods.lock.json',
                'scripts/prepare_photon_taau_screen.py', 'scripts/run_proof_matrix.py', 'scripts/prepare_isolations.py',
                'scripts/setup_comparison.py', 'scripts/prepare_reduced_effects_profiles.py', 'scripts/prepare_photon_ao_reuse_profiles.py')]
            for tree in ('src/main', 'src/devClient'): source_paths += [p for p in (root / tree).rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
            state['immutable_source_files_sha256'] = {str(p): file_hash(p) for p in sorted(set(source_paths))}
            state.update(status='complete', launch_authorized=False, owned_live_processes=[])
            write_json(marker, state)
        except BaseException as error:
            state.update(status='failed', error=str(error)); write_json(marker, state); raise
    return state


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True); parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path, default=SOURCE)
    parser.add_argument('--audit', type=Path, default=AUDIT); parser.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result = plan(args.output, args.source) if args.dry_run else prepare(args.output, args.source, audit=args.audit)
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        parser.exit(1, 'Cannot prepare Photon TAAU screen: ' + str(error) + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

def prepare_scene(args, scene):
    base = args.output / scene

        raise ValueError(f'Preserving existing proof profiles: {base}; choose a fresh --output')
    camera = args.water_camera if scene == 'coastalwater' else None
    workload = argparse.Namespace(source=args.source, output=args.output, scene=scene,
        pack=args.pack, source_world=WORLD, config_only=False, replace_worlds=False,

        cloud_upscaling=args.cloud_upscaling if scene == 'cloudstorm' else 4)

    for key in ('enabled', 'terrainEnabled', 'terrainChunkCap', 'warmSourceConfirmed'):
        control.pop(key, None)

                'SHADERLOD_CLOUD_NEAR=128.0\nSHADERLOD_CLOUD_FAR=1024.0\nSHADERLOD_CLOUD_TRANSITION=64.0\n')
        if args.without_dh:

        'camera_verified': False if scene == 'coastalwater' else True,
        'validation': 'Pinned source/options, copied warm data; runtime validation pending'})
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'run-workloads/photon-proof')
    p.add_argument('--source', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'run-workloads/forest/high')
    p.add_argument('--pack', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'run/shaderpacks' / PACK)
    p.add_argument('--scenes', nargs='+', choices=('forest', 'cloudstorm', 'coastalwater'), default=['forest', 'cloudstorm'])
    p.add_argument('--without-dh', action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--cloud-upscaling', type=int, choices=(1,2,3,4), default=1)
    p.add_argument('--water-camera', nargs=5, type=float, default=[200.5,70.0,680.5,135.0,7.0])
    args = p.parse_args()
    if len(args.scenes) != len(set(args.scenes)): p.error('Duplicate scenes')
    try:
        for scene in args.scenes: prepare_scene(args, scene)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        p.exit(1, f'Cannot prepare proof profiles: {error}\n')

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare pinned original/off/combined reduced-SSR profiles; no build or client."""
from __future__ import annotations
from run_storage import copytree as storage_copytree

import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tomllib
import zipfile

from analyze_inprocess_control import ssr_cost_members, validate_ssr_cost_qualification
from prepare_isolations import archive_contents, filter_effective_options, ORIGINAL_SHA256
from run_proof_matrix import (archive_defaults, canonical_options_hash, normalize_requested_options,
                              read_option_properties, require_exclusive_runtime)
from setup_comparison import ROOT, WORLD, file_hash, unlocked_world, world_fingerprint

REDUCED_SHA256 = '636a164832f5d4915548e288491a83e33f14a591f72987c77b7d8931e9800f83'
REDUCED_ARCHIVE = ROOT / 'build/Photon-SSRFarReducedTraceProbe-enabled.zip'
DEFAULT_SOURCES = {'forest': ROOT / 'run-workloads/native-terrain-b15-r2/forest/high',
                   'coastalwater': ROOT / 'run-workloads/photon-ssr-cost-controls-r1/coastalwater/high'}
ARMS = ('high', 'patched-off', 'adaptive')
SCENES = tuple(DEFAULT_SOURCES)
OVERRIDES = ('enabled', 'terrainEnabled', 'terrainChunkCap', 'warmSourceConfirmed')
POSES = {'forest': {'x': 256.5, 'y': 95.0, 'z': 768.5, 'yaw': 135.0, 'pitch': 9.0, 'time': 7000},
         'coastalwater': {'x': 500.5, 'y': 68.0, 'z': 660.5, 'yaw': 87.38, 'pitch': 3.735, 'time': 12500}}
PATCHED_FLAGS = dict.fromkeys(('SHADERLOD_CLOUDS', 'SHADERLOD_WATER', 'SHADERLOD_FOG',
                             'SHADERLOD_SSR', 'SHADERLOD_MATERIALS'), 'true') | {
    'SHADERLOD_USE_MOD_CONFIG': 'true', 'SHADERLOD_PRESERVE_LIGHTING': 'true',
    'SHADERLOD_CACHED_SKY': 'false', 'SHADERLOD_WATER_ANALYTIC': 'false', 'SHADERLOD_DEBUG': 'false',
    'SHADERLOD_NEAR': '32.0', 'SHADERLOD_FAR': '96.0', 'SHADERLOD_TRANSITION': '8.0',
    'PHOTON_SSR_FAR_REDUCED_TRACE_PROBE': 'true'}
TRANSIENT = ('saves', 'shaderpacks', 'logs', 'screenshots', 'camera-quality', 'camera-quality*',
             'benchmark*.json', 'benchmark*.json.tmp', 'workload-request*.json', 'workload-measurement*.json')


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition: raise ValueError(message)


def plan(output, scenes=SCENES, sources=None, reduced_archive=REDUCED_ARCHIVE):
    """Pure explicit paths/pins; no archive/save reads or client invocation."""
    sources = DEFAULT_SOURCES | (sources or {})
    output, reduced_archive = Path(output), Path(reduced_archive)
    require(not output.is_symlink() and not reduced_archive.is_symlink(), 'No symlink destinations/archive selection')
    output, reduced_archive = output.resolve(), reduced_archive.resolve()
    require(not output.exists(), 'Preserving existing output; use a fresh directory')
    require(scenes and len(scenes) == len(set(scenes)) and set(scenes) <= set(SCENES), 'Unknown/empty/duplicate scenes')
    operations = []
    for scene in scenes:
        source = Path(sources[scene])
        require(not source.is_symlink(), 'No symlink source profile')
        source = source.resolve()
        require(source != output and source not in output.parents and output not in source.parents
                and source.parent != output and source.parent not in output.parents,
                'Output must be separate from source collection')
        operations.append({'scene': scene, 'source_profile': str(source),
                           'target_profiles': {arm: str(output / scene / arm) for arm in ARMS}})
    require(output != reduced_archive and output not in reduced_archive.parents, 'Output may not contain source archive')
    return {'schema': 1, 'output': str(output), 'scene_operations': operations,
            'original_sha256': ORIGINAL_SHA256, 'reduced_archive': str(reduced_archive), 'reduced_sha256': REDUCED_SHA256,
            'arms': list(ARMS), 'dh_present': False, 'requested_chunks': 24,
            'validation': 'Pure plan only; runtime/source qualification and copies pending'}


def control_for_scene(control, scene):
    result = dict(control)
    removed = {name: result.pop(name) for name in OVERRIDES if name in result}
    require(all(result.get(name) == value for name, value in POSES[scene].items()), 'Source inspected pose/time changed: ' + scene)
    require(result.get('weather') == 'clear' and result.get('preset') == 'PERFORMANCE' and result.get('debug') is False,
            'Source weather/preset/debug not the inspected control')
    require(not ({'capture', 'cameraQuality', 'terrainCap'} & result.keys()), 'Unsafe capture/terrain override in control')
    return result, removed


def fresh_config(arm):
    require(arm in ARMS, 'Unknown arm')
    return ('[lod]\nenabled=' + str(arm == 'adaptive').lower() + '\npreset="PERFORMANCE"\n'
            'near=32.0\nfar=96.0\ntransition=8.0\ndebug=false\n'
            '[terrain]\nenabled=false\nvanillaChunkCap=16\nwarmSourceConfirmed=false\nwarmupSeconds=30\n'
            '[rendering]\noptimizeShadowCulling=false\nseparateShadowVisibilityLists=false\nshadowFrustumCoherence=false\n')


def native_options(profile, original, reduced):
    option_path = profile / 'shaderpacks' / (read_option_properties((profile / 'config/iris.properties').read_text())['shaderPack'] + '.txt')
    requested = read_option_properties(option_path.read_text()) if option_path.exists() else {}
    report_path = profile / 'workload-measurement.json'
    require(report_path.is_file(), 'Inspected original loaded-option evidence missing')
    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
    require(report.get('status') == 'complete' and report.get('actual_shader_sha256') == ORIGINAL_SHA256,
            'Original source report pin/status mismatch')
    effective = report.get('effective_shader_options')
    require(isinstance(effective, dict) and effective and report.get('effective_shader_options_sha256') == canonical_options_hash(effective),
            'Original source effective option fingerprint mismatch')
    native, evidence = filter_effective_options(effective, requested, original, reduced)
    patched = native | PATCHED_FLAGS
    with zipfile.ZipFile(Path(reduced['path'])) as archive: reduced_defaults = archive_defaults(archive)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(Path(original['path'])) as archive: original_defaults = archive_defaults(archive)
    normalize_requested_options(original_defaults, native)
    normalize_requested_options(reduced_defaults, patched)
    for name, value in original_defaults.items():
        if name in reduced_defaults and not name.startswith('SHADERLOD_'):
            require(reduced_defaults[name] == value, 'Reduced archive changed upstream default: ' + name)
    require(not any(name.startswith(('SHADERLOD_', 'PHOTON_SSR_FAR_')) for name in native), 'Original source contains experimental switches')
    return native, patched, evidence


def qualify_archives(original_path, reduced_path, runtime):
    photon = runtime['artifacts']['photon']
    original = archive_contents(original_path, ORIGINAL_SHA256, photon)
    require(file_hash(original_path, 'sha512') == photon['hashes']['sha512'], 'Original runtime-lock checksum mismatch')
    reduced = archive_contents(reduced_path, REDUCED_SHA256, photon, original['license_bytes'])
    with zipfile.ZipFile(reduced_path) as archive:
        members = {name: hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest() for name in ssr_cost_members(REDUCED_SHA256)}
        probe = json.loads(archive.read('shaderlod-ssr-far-reduced-probe.json'))
    qualification = {'qualified': True, 'archive_sha256': REDUCED_SHA256, 'policy': 'reduced',
                     'member_sha256': members, 'probe_metadata': probe}
    validate_ssr_cost_qualification(qualification)
    original['path'], reduced['path'] = str(original_path), str(reduced_path)
    return original, reduced, qualification


def inspect_scene(item, reduced_path, runtime):
    scene, profile = item['scene'], Path(item['source_profile'])
    require(not any(path.is_symlink() for path in profile.rglob('*')), 'Symlinks in source tree are unsupported')
    world = profile / 'saves' / WORLD
    require((world / 'level.dat').is_file(), 'Stopped original source save missing')
    manifest_path, control_path = profile.parent / 'workload-manifest.json', profile.parent / 'control.json'
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    require(manifest.get('configuration_only') is False and manifest.get('source_world_sha256'), 'Source save provenance missing')
    control, removed = control_for_scene(json.loads(control_path.read_text()), scene)
    iris_path = profile / 'config/iris.properties'
    iris = read_option_properties(iris_path.read_text())
    selected = iris.get('shaderPack', '')
    require(selected and Path(selected).name == selected and iris.get('enableShaders') == 'true', 'Invalid source Iris pack selection')
    original_path = profile / 'shaderpacks' / selected
    original, reduced, qualification = qualify_archives(original_path, reduced_path, runtime)
    native, patched, option_evidence = native_options(profile, original, reduced)
    options_path = profile / 'options.txt'
    minecraft = {key: value for line in options_path.read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line for key, value in [line.split(':', 1)]}
    require(minecraft.get('renderDistance') == '24', 'Original source requested radius must remain24')
    jars = sorted((profile / 'mods').glob('*.jar'))
    dh = runtime['artifacts']['distanthorizons']
    if scene == 'forest':
        require(len(jars) == 1 and jars[0].name == dh['filename'] and file_hash(jars[0], 'sha512') == dh['hashes']['sha512'],
                'Forest source must contain only its pinned DH jar')
    else:
        require(not jars, 'Coastal source must contain no profile mod jars')
    files = [manifest_path, control_path, iris_path, options_path, original_path, reduced_path,
             profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml', profile / 'workload-measurement.json', *jars]
    for path in (profile / 'shaderpacks' / (selected + '.txt'), profile / 'config/DistantHorizons.toml', profile / 'config/sodium-options.json'):
        if path.exists(): files.append(path)
    require(all(path.is_file() for path in files), 'Source config/provenance file missing')
    tomllib.loads((profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml').read_text())
    return {'scene': scene, 'profile': profile, 'world': world, 'manifest': manifest, 'control': control,
            'removed_control_overrides': removed, 'original': original, 'reduced': reduced, 'qualification': qualification,
            'native_options': native, 'patched_options': patched, 'option_evidence': option_evidence,
            'source_files_sha256': {str(path): file_hash(path) for path in files},
            'provenance_files': {'control-original.json': control_path, 'workload-manifest-original.json': manifest_path,
                'shaderlod-client-original.toml': profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml',
                'iris-original.properties': iris_path, 'options-original.txt': options_path}}


def write_json(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')


def prepare(output, scenes=SCENES, sources=None, reduced_archive=REDUCED_ARCHIVE, runtime_lock=None):
    operation = plan(output, scenes, sources, reduced_archive)
    require_exclusive_runtime()
    runtime_lock = Path(runtime_lock or ROOT / 'dev/runtime.lock.json')
    runtime = json.loads(runtime_lock.read_text())
    output = Path(operation['output'])
    with ExitStack() as locks:
        for item in operation['scene_operations']: locks.enter_context(unlocked_world(Path(item['source_profile']) / 'saves' / WORLD))
        selected = [inspect_scene(item, Path(operation['reduced_archive']), runtime) for item in operation['scene_operations']]
        for scene in selected: scene['world_sha256'] = world_fingerprint(scene['world'])
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
        state = {'schema': 1, 'status': 'preparing', 'operation': operation,
                 'created_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'runtime_lock_sha256': file_hash(runtime_lock),
                 'validation': 'Preparation only; compilation/rendering/performance/quality pending', 'scenes': {}}
        state_path = output / 'reduced-effects-preparation.json'; write_json(state_path, state)
        try:
            for scene in selected:
                base = output / scene['scene']; base.mkdir()
                provenance = base / 'source-provenance'; provenance.mkdir()
                for name, path in scene['provenance_files'].items(): shutil.copy2(path, provenance / name)
                copies, arms = {}, {}
                for arm in ARMS:
                    profile = base / arm
                    storage_copytree(scene['profile'], profile, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(*TRANSIENT))
                    world = profile / 'saves' / WORLD; world.parent.mkdir()
                    storage_copytree(scene['world'], world, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('session.lock'))
                    copies[arm] = world_fingerprint(world)
                    require(copies[arm] == scene['world_sha256'], 'Copied canonical save differs: ' + arm)
                    dh_jar = profile / 'mods' / runtime['artifacts']['distanthorizons']['filename']
                    removed_dh = dh_jar.exists()
                    if removed_dh:
                        require(scene['scene'] == 'forest', 'Unexpected fresh coastal DH jar')
                        require(file_hash(dh_jar, 'sha512') == runtime['artifacts']['distanthorizons']['hashes']['sha512'], 'Fresh copied DH jar differs from pin')
                        dh_jar.unlink()  # Only this fresh copied, already-qualified DH jar.
                    require(not any((profile / 'mods').glob('*.jar')), 'Fresh output has unmanaged profile mods')
                    archive = scene['original'] if arm == 'high' else scene['reduced']
                    archive_path = Path(archive['path']); (profile / 'shaderpacks').mkdir()
                    shutil.copy2(archive_path, profile / 'shaderpacks' / archive_path.name)
                    options = scene['native_options'] if arm == 'high' else scene['patched_options']
                    (profile / 'shaderpacks' / (archive_path.name + '.txt')).write_text(''.join(f'{name}={value}\n' for name, value in sorted(options.items())))
                    iris = read_option_properties((profile / 'config/iris.properties').read_text())
                    iris['shaderPack'] = archive_path.name
                    (profile / 'config/iris.properties').write_text(''.join(f'{name}={value}\n' for name, value in sorted(iris.items())))
                    (profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml').write_text(fresh_config(arm))
                    require(file_hash(profile / 'shaderpacks' / archive_path.name) == archive['sha256'], 'Copied archive changed')
                    arms[arm] = {'archive': archive_path.name, 'sha256': archive['sha256'], 'requested_options': options,
                                 'global_enabled': arm == 'adaptive', 'main_mod_present': arm != 'high',
                                 'dh_present': False, 'removed_fresh_copied_dh_jar': removed_dh,
                                 'config_sha256': file_hash(profile / 'config/shaderlod-client.toml')}
                require(world_fingerprint(scene['world']) == scene['world_sha256'], 'Source world changed during copying')
                require({path: file_hash(Path(path)) for path in scene['source_files_sha256']} == scene['source_files_sha256'], 'Source files changed during preparation')
                write_json(base / 'control.json', scene['control'])
                manifest = {'schema': 1, 'scene': scene['scene'], 'created_at_utc': state['created_at_utc'],
                    'configuration_only': False, 'preparation_status': 'complete', 'proof_profiles': list(ARMS),
                    'source_world': str(scene['world']), 'source_world_sha256': scene['world_sha256'], 'copied_world_sha256': copies,
                    'source_provenance': scene['manifest'], 'source_files_sha256': scene['source_files_sha256'],
                    'source_option_evidence': scene['option_evidence'], 'control': scene['control'],
                    'removed_control_overrides': scene['removed_control_overrides'], 'experiment_family': 'reduced-ssr-all-five-effects',
                    'experiment_arms': arms, 'quality_options': {arm: arms[arm]['requested_options'] for arm in ARMS},
                    'original_sha256': ORIGINAL_SHA256, 'adaptive_pack_sha256': REDUCED_SHA256,
                    'reduced_source_qualification': scene['qualification'], 'requested_chunks': 24,
                    'dh_installed': False, 'geometry_enabled': False, 'shader_only': True,
                    'validation': 'Pinned archives/options/config, canonical equal copies and physical DH removal only; real no-DH/native rendering and repeated performance/quality pending'}
                write_json(base / 'workload-manifest.json', manifest)
                state['scenes'][scene['scene']] = {'source_world_sha256': scene['world_sha256'], 'copied_world_sha256': copies}
                write_json(state_path, state)
            state.update(status='complete', completed_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()); write_json(state_path, state)
        except BaseException as error:
            state.update(status='failed', error=str(error)); write_json(state_path, state); raise
    return state


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--scene', choices=('both', *SCENES), default='both')
    parser.add_argument('--forest-source', type=Path, default=DEFAULT_SOURCES['forest'])
    parser.add_argument('--coastal-source', type=Path, default=DEFAULT_SOURCES['coastalwater'])
    parser.add_argument('--reduced-archive', type=Path, default=REDUCED_ARCHIVE, help='Alternate explicit location; same exact hash required')
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true', help='Pure path/pin plan; no archive/save reads or copies')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    scenes = SCENES if args.scene == 'both' else (args.scene,)
    sources = {'forest': args.forest_source, 'coastalwater': args.coastal_source}
    try:
        result = plan(args.output, scenes, sources, args.reduced_archive) if args.dry_run else prepare(args.output, scenes, sources, args.reduced_archive)
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        parser.exit(1, 'Cannot prepare reduced combined profiles: ' + str(error) + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

FREEZE = Path('build/photon-shared-spatial-freeze.json')

MANIFEST_SHA256 = 'bd9fbf3f70bb117a1825f630cc3a20e34089bd7bf9f8dd14377e2cc72ac582fa'

REPORT_SHA256, OPTIONS_SHA256 = parallel.SOURCE_PINS['forest']
ARCHIVES = {

        'privateON-FULL': ('enabled', 'FULL'), 'privateON-ADAPTIVE': ('enabled', 'ADAPTIVE')}

def qualify(root=ROOT, paths=None, freeze=None):
    """Inspect reviewed inputs in memory; no builder invocation or ZIP writes."""
    root = Path(root)
    manifest_path = root / adapter.MANIFEST
    require(file_hash(manifest_path) == MANIFEST_SHA256, 'Reviewed spatial manifest drift')
    freeze_path = Path(freeze) if freeze else root / FREEZE
    require(file_hash(freeze_path) == FREEZE_SHA256, 'Reviewed complete source freeze drift')
    ledger = json.loads(freeze_path.read_text())
    require(set(ledger) == set(ARCHIVES), 'Frozen arm inventory drift')
    runtime = json.loads((root / 'dev/runtime.lock.json').read_text())
    base = root / adapter.BASE
    original = archive_contents(base, adapter.BASE_SHA256, runtime['artifacts']['photon'])
    require(file_hash(base, 'sha512') == runtime['artifacts']['photon']['hashes']['sha512'], 'Runtime Photon pin drift')
    originals = adapter.archive_members(base)
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    overlay = adapter.overlays(root, manifest, originals)
    selected = {}
    for arm, digest in ARCHIVES.items():
        path = Path(paths[arm]) if paths and arm in paths else root / 'build' / f'Photon-SharedSpatial-{arm}.zip'
        require(not path.is_symlink(), 'Symlink archive unsupported')
        actual = adapter.archive_members(path)
        expected = adapter.patch_members(originals, manifest, arm)
        if arm != 'original': expected.update(overlay)
        require(set(actual) == set(expected) | {adapter.METADATA}, 'Spatial archive member inventory drift: ' + arm)
        require(actual['LICENSE'] == originals['LICENSE'], 'Photon license drift: ' + arm)
        require(all(actual[n] == b for n, b in expected.items()), 'Reviewed spatial member bytes drift: ' + arm)
        row = ledger[arm]
        require(row['archive_sha256'] == digest, 'Frozen archive pin drift: ' + arm)
        metadata = json.loads(actual[adapter.METADATA])
        require(metadata == {k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ('archive_sha256', 'reference_registration')},
                'Complete metadata/layout/options drift: ' + arm)
        pins = row['reference_member_sha256']
        require(all(adapter.sha256(actual[n]) == pin for n,pin in pins.items()), 'Reference member pin drift: ' + arm)
        registration = row['reference_registration']
        expected_bindings = [] if arm == 'original' else [dict(sourceSha256=digest, memberSha256=pins,
            requiredOptions=row['required_effective_options'])]
        require(registration['sourceBindings'] == expected_bindings and registration['layout'] == manifest['layout'],
                'Reviewed source registration/layout drift: ' + arm)
        require(registration['protocols'] == {'shaderlod:core':[2], 'shaderlod:effects':[2], 'shaderlod:capabilities':[1]}
                and registration['capability'] == dict(effect='opaque_lighting', kind='rate',
                    operation='shaderlod:opaque_spatial_irradiance', retainedRates=[1.,.25])
                and registration['export'] == dict(operation='shaderlod:opaque_spatial_irradiance', uniform='shaderlodOpaqueSpatialAvailable'),
                'Reviewed protocol/capability drift: ' + arm)
        require(file_hash(path) == digest, 'Complete reviewed archive bytes drift: ' + arm)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z: defaults = matrix.archive_defaults(z)
        require(defaults.get(adapter.SWITCH) == (None if arm == 'original' else str(arm == 'enabled').lower()),
                'Frozen private switch default drift: ' + arm)
        selected[arm] = dict(path=str(path.resolve()), sha256=digest, metadata=metadata,
            reference_registration=registration, complete_member_sha256={n:adapter.sha256(b) for n,b in actual.items()})
    return dict(qualified=True, freeze_sha256=FREEZE_SHA256, manifest_sha256=MANIFEST_SHA256,
        runtime_lock_sha256=file_hash(root / 'dev/runtime.lock.json'), runtime_lock=runtime,
        artifacts=selected, upstream=original | dict(path=str(base)))


def inspect_scene(source=SOURCE, root=ROOT, qualified=None):

    require(file_hash(report_path) == REPORT_SHA256, 'Canonical forest source report drift')

                and state['requested_chunks'] == state['effective_chunks'] == 24
                and state['shaders_in_use'] is True and state['fallback'] is False, 'Native source state drift')
    parent = profile.parent

    iris = matrix.read_option_properties((profile/'config/iris.properties').read_text()); selected = iris.get('shaderPack','')

    pack = profile/'shaderpacks'/selected
    require(file_hash(pack) == adapter.BASE_SHA256, 'Source original archive drift')
    requested = matrix.read_option_properties(pack.with_name(selected+'.txt').read_text())
    original = qualified['upstream']
    native, evidence = filter_effective_options(effective, requested, original, original)
    require(native | evidence['omitted_non_settings_defaults'] == effective, 'Complete upstream options not held')
    require(not any(n.startswith('SHADERLOD_') for n in effective), 'Upstream private option contamination')
    for arm,row in qualified['artifacts'].items():
        with zipfile.ZipFile(row['path']) as z: defaults = matrix.archive_defaults(z)
        options = native | ({} if arm == 'original' else {adapter.SWITCH:str(arm == 'enabled').lower()})
        matrix.normalize_requested_options(defaults, options)
        for n,allowed in row['metadata']['required_effective_options'].items():

    game = dict(line.split(':',1) for line in (profile/'options.txt').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line)

    runtime = qualified['runtime_lock']; dh = runtime['artifacts']['distanthorizons']

    require(len(jars) == 1 and jars[0].name == dh['filename'] and file_hash(jars[0],'sha512') == dh['hashes']['sha512'], 'Source DH inventory drift')
    files = [report_path, manifest_path, control_path, pack, pack.with_name(selected+'.txt'), *jars]
    files += [p for p in profile.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and (p.is_relative_to(profile/'config') or p.is_relative_to(profile/'resourcepacks'))]
    files.append(profile/'options.txt')
    return dict(profile=profile, world=world, control=control, removed_control_overrides=removed,
        native_options=native, upstream_effective_options=effective, option_evidence=evidence,
        source_loaded_mods=report['loaded_mods'], source_files_sha256={str(p):file_hash(p) for p in files})
